玩家就是帮助这名天残谷谷主夺回王权和帮助其他天残兽人的助力。

商非凡还有很多问题想要问虎不帅，虎不帅却不想再说更多，还直接下楼了。

商非凡也只得下楼吃早饭。

早上的酒馆客人很少，只有酒馆老板一家和几名留宿的客人在吃早饭。

两名年纪较大的女性兽人拎着打扫工具上楼打扫卫生。

商非凡特地坐到了虎不帅身边。

早上吃的同样是又干又硬的麦饼和一碗蔬菜汤。

“为什么你能听见虫子呓语？你也有浓郁的虫族血脉？”商非凡把麦饼撕碎丢进蔬菜汤里。

“不是，我是聆听者。”虎不帅面色有点无奈，望望周围，压低声音：“拥有虫族血脉并不是什么好事，不要再多说。”

商非凡换了一个问题：“什么是聆听者？”

虎不帅：“……你没有距离感吗？”

商非凡比划了两人之间的距离：“我们之间有遥远的两兽尺距离。”

虎不帅低头。

“你笑了。”

虎不帅轻咳。

商非凡：“所以什么是聆听者？你不回答，我也可以问别人。”

虎不帅抬头，“你让我怀疑你真的是来自黑森林城吗？你的常识缺乏得让人惊讶。”

商非凡指指自己的脑袋：“你忘了？我告诉过你，我脑袋被砸过，忘了不少事情。”

虎不帅也不知是信还是不信：“我现在有点后悔告诉你虫子在你房间呓语的事了。聆听者是我们兽人的神血天赋能力之一，我可以听到一些别人听不到的声音。”

“比如死者的声音？”商非凡满脸兴味。

虎不帅没有回答，低头吃起自己的早餐。

商非凡也用叉子叉了一块泡软的麦饼放进口中咀嚼，过了一会儿说：“看来酒馆老板请的厨子只会做蔬菜汤，我厨艺不错，下次请你吃好的。”

虎不帅压根没把这句话当真，只含糊嗯了一声。

吃完早饭没多久，小安东就兴冲冲地带着两个人跑回来了。

一位是治安官安德烈，还有一位则是一名头上长着小小羊角的女性兽人。

“听说你房间里发现了大量虫尸？昨晚一同去的其他人都没有异常情况发生，只有你。先去你房间看看。”治安官没有废话，说完就向楼上走。

小安东想要跟上去，被他妈妈拉住。

酒馆老板跟了上去。

商非凡转头，就看到虎不帅跟在他身后。

到了商非凡房间门口，治安官停下脚步，侧身：“羊大婶，麻烦你先看看。”

羊大婶看起来有五十多岁，不算很老，但头发全白，也许她的发色原本就是白的。

她的衣着打扮也很普通，就像是家门口最常见的中年妇女。

几个人让开道路，让落在后面的羊大婶先进入房间。

羊大婶对几个人温和地笑了笑，从腰间掏出一个拨浪鼓一样的小鼓，一边转动，一边走入客房。

小鼓发出咚咚的响声。

商非凡仔细观察，发现羊大婶走路的节奏竟然和鼓声吻合。

羊大婶转动小鼓，围着床铺走了一圈，最后停在大堆虫尸面前。

羊大婶把小鼓对准床单上的虫尸，以一种奇异的节奏来回转动。

大约两三分钟后，鼓声停止。

羊大婶转头，额头竟然有汗：“不是虫族，只是普通虫子。”

闻言，治安官和酒馆老板全都松了口气。

商非凡心思转动，突然说道：“昨晚我似乎听到虫鸣声，像是虫子在对我说话。这是什么情况？”

羊大婶腾地看向商非凡：“你听到虫子说什么了吗？”

商非凡摇头：“没听清楚，我昨晚太累，睡得比较沉。”

站在门外的虎不帅也保持了沉默，他甚至有点佩服商非凡的大胆，竟然敢说出虫子呓语的事，也许这人真的被砸到脑子失去了大部分常识。

羊大婶皱眉。

治安官却走到虎不帅身边，很肯定地问他：“你是不是也听到了什么？”

虎不帅看了眼商非凡，诚实回答：“听到了，但只听到几个单词，虫人骨灰、荒蓟草、蛋黄、诅咒。我正想请教羊大婶这些单词代表了什么意思，是不是神血天赋的激发配方？”

所有人都看向羊大婶。

羊大婶表情有点惊讶，也有点同情……地看向商非凡：“这不是神血天赋的激发配方，这是诅咒。如果你在你房间周围寻找，应该能找到虫人骨灰、荒蓟草和蛋黄这三样东西。”

唰！所有人又把目光转向商非凡。

商非凡特别淡定：“我被凶手诅咒了吗？”

治安官手指擦过眉毛：“有可能。”

“我去问问牛婶她们。”酒馆老板迅速跑出客房。

没多会儿，酒馆老板就拎着一些东西跑回来告诉众人：“找到了！牛婶他们收集厕所垃圾桶时，在里面发现了一个完整的蛋黄。另外，她们打扫墙角时发现了一株荒蓟草。虫人骨灰没发现，但是……”

但是肯定有。

“蛋黄和荒蓟草都好说，虫人骨灰不是那么容易得到，最近焚烧的虫人只有昨晚那位。他的骨灰现在在哪里？”商非凡问治安官。

昨晚是治安官带走了骨灰罐。

治安官：“我放在了镇子祭堂，打算这两天就找时间把它埋在镇子墓地里。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 6: This is a Curse

Shang Feifan felt that he needed to have a proper discussion with the indigenous Orcs to understand the broader background of this world, content that was entirely absent from the game forums.

According to the game developers, the game world's background was described as a relatively primitive Orc world, as well as a massive open gaming world where players could do whatever they pleased.

They could conquer the world, become merchants, simply admire the scenery, or take on a questline to help the Orcs of this world develop.

Before all that, to ensure players' safety, they first had to establish safe zones and player factions—which was precisely what the vast majority of players were currently doing.

Of course, any game had a main storyline.

And this game was no exception.

All players were born in the Rebirth Pool of the Temple of Heaven's Flaw, and from birth, they were considered "Flawed."

This included the indigenous Orcs within the novice village of Heaven's Flaw Valley.

What was meant by "Flawed"?

It referred to Orcs who were innately unable to freely transform between their beast forms and human forms.

Aside from that, Orcs born with various other physical defects were also labeled as Flawed.

These Flawed Orcs were subjected to discrimination by normal Orcs, and many were abandoned by their own families. At some point in time, numerous Valleys of Heaven's Flaw and Villages of Heaven's Flaw began to spring up everywhere. These places specialized in taking in the Flawed, and outsiders would deliberately send Flawed children there.

The main storyline of the game centered around these Flawed Orcs striving to carve out a territory of their own, wanting ordinary Orcs to know that the Flawed were neither pathetic nor weak, and hoping to establish an Orc regime where even the Flawed could live happily.

Their leader was the Master of Heaven's Flaw Valley. Rumor had it that his background was also quite extraordinary—an abandoned royal Orc prince. However, he had awakened a bloodline skill said to be exclusive to pure royal bloodlines, and he had taken a knowledgeable teacher to learn a vast amount of knowledge. Sympathizing with the plight of other Flawed individuals, he wanted to take action.

The players served as the supporting force to help this Master of Heaven's Flaw Valley reclaim royal power and assist the other Flawed Orcs.

Shang Feifan still had many questions he wanted to ask Hu Bushuai, but Hu Bushuai had no desire to say any more and went straight downstairs.

Left with no choice, Shang Feifan went downstairs for breakfast as well.

The tavern had very few patrons in the morning; only the tavern owner's family and a few lodging guests were eating breakfast.

Two older female Orcs were carrying cleaning tools upstairs to tidy the rooms.

Shang Feifan deliberately went to sit next to Hu Bushuai.

Breakfast was the same dry, hard barley flatbread and a bowl of vegetable soup.

"Why could you hear the bugs' murmurs? Do you also possess a potent Zerg bloodline?" Shang Feifan broke the barley flatbread into pieces and tossed them into the vegetable soup.

"No, I am a Listener." Hu Bushuai's expression carried a trace of helplessness as he glanced around and lowered his voice, "Possessing a Zerg bloodline is no good thing. Say no more of this."

Shang Feifan changed the question. "What is a Listener?"

Hu Bushuai: "...Do you have no sense of personal space?"

Shang Feifan gestured at the distance between the two of them. "There is a distant two beast-feet between us."

Hu Bushuai lowered his head.

"You smiled."

Hu Bushuai gave a light cough.

Shang Feifan: "So, what is a Listener? If you won't answer, I can ask someone else."

Hu Bushuai looked up. "You make me doubt whether you really come from Black Forest City. Your lack of common sense is astonishing."

Shang Feifan pointed at his own head. "Did you forget? I told you, my head took a blow, and I forgot quite a few things."

Whether he believed it or not, Hu Bushuai said, "I'm starting to regret telling you about the bugs murmuring in your room. A Listener is one of our Orcs' divine blood talent abilities; I can hear certain sounds that others cannot."

"Like the voices of the dead?" Shang Feifan's face was full of intrigue.

Hu Bushuai did not answer; he lowered his head and began eating his breakfast.

Shang Feifan also used his fork to spear a piece of soaked barley flatbread, chewed it in his mouth, and after a moment said, "It seems the cook hired by the tavern only knows how to make vegetable soup. My culinary skills are quite good; next time, I'll treat you to something better."

Hu Bushuai didn't take the remark seriously at all and merely gave a vague grunt in response.

Not long after breakfast, little Anton came running back excitedly, accompanied by two people.

One was Magistrate Andrei, and the other was a female Orc with a pair of small sheep horns atop her head.

"I heard a massive number of bug corpses were found in your room? None of the others who went together last night had any abnormalities, only you. Let's go take a look in your room first." The magistrate didn't waste words; as soon as he finished speaking, he headed upstairs.

Little Anton wanted to follow, but his mother held him back.

The tavern owner followed closely behind.

Shang Feifan turned his head and saw Hu Bushuai trailing right behind him.

Arriving at the door of Shang Feifan's room, the magistrate stopped and stepped aside. "Auntie Yang, sorry to trouble you to take a look first."

Auntie Yang looked to be around fifty years old. She wasn't particularly old, but her hair was completely white—though perhaps her hair color had been white to begin with.

Her attire was also very ordinary, resembling the most typical middle-aged housewife you might see right on your doorstep.

The others cleared a path, allowing Auntie Yang, who was bringing up the rear, to enter the room first.

Auntie Yang smiled gently at the few of them, drew a small drum resembling a pellet drum from her waist, and spun it while walking into the guest room.

The small drum emitted a *thump-thump* sound.

Observing closely, Shang Feifan discovered that the rhythm of Auntie Yang's footsteps actually matched the beating of the drum.

Auntie Yang spun the small drum, walked a circle around the bed, and finally stopped in front of the pile of bug corpses.

She aimed the small drum at the bug corpses on the bedsheet, spinning it back and forth in a strange rhythm.

After about two or three minutes, the drum sounds ceased.

Auntie Yang turned her head, beads of sweat actually dotting her forehead. "Not Zerg. Just ordinary bugs."

Hearing this, both the magistrate and the tavern owner breathed a sigh of relief.

Thoughts turning in his mind, Shang Feifan suddenly spoke up, "Last night, I seemed to hear insect chirping sounds, as if the bugs were talking to me. What is going on here?"

Auntie Yang snapped her head around to look at Shang Feifan. "Did you hear what the bugs said?"

Shang Feifan shook his head. "I didn't hear it clearly. I was too tired last night and fell asleep rather heavily."

Hu Bushuai, standing outside the door, also maintained his silence. He even felt a measure of admiration for Shang Feifan's audacity, actually daring to bring up the subject of bug murmurs. Perhaps this fellow really had taken a blow to the head and lost most of his common sense.

Auntie Yang frowned.

However, the magistrate walked over to Hu Bushuai and asked him with absolute certainty, "Did you hear something as well?"

Hu Bushuai glanced at Shang Feifan and answered honestly, "I heard it, but I only caught a few words: insect-man ash, wild thistle, egg yolk, curse. I was just about to ask Auntie Yang what these words mean. Could they be the recipe to awaken a divine blood talent?"

Everyone turned their gazes toward Auntie Yang.

Auntie Yang's expression held a hint of surprise, and she looked at Shang Feifan with a touch of sympathy. "This is not a recipe for awakening a divine blood talent; this is a curse. If you search around your room, you should be able to find those three items: insect-man ash, wild thistle, and egg yolk."

Swish! Everyone shifted their gazes back to Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan remained exceptionally calm. "Have I been cursed by the murderer?"

The magistrate brushed a finger across his eyebrow. "It's possible."

"I'll go ask Auntie Niu and the others." The tavern owner bolted out of the guest room.

Before long, the tavern owner came running back carrying a few items and told the crowd, "Found them! When Auntie Niu and the others were collecting the trash from the restrooms, they found a whole egg yolk inside. Also, when they were cleaning the corner of the wall, they found a stalk of wild thistle. The insect-man ash wasn't found, but..."

But it certainly existed.

"Egg yolks and wild thistle are easy enough to come by, but insect-man ash isn't so easily obtained. The only insect-man cremated recently was the one from last night. Where is his ash now?" Shang Feifan asked the magistrate.

The magistrate had been the one to take the urn of ashes away last night.

The magistrate replied, "I placed it in the town's ancestral hall, intending to find time to bury it in the town cemetery in the next couple of days."

chunks.chineseText:
治安官脸色难看，不等商非凡询问就说：“镇子祭堂平时没人去，那里也没有什么重要东西，看管不严。”

“也就是说谁都能进去弄到虫人骨灰。”商非凡说。

治安官默认了这个说法。

商非凡又看向酒馆老板：“昨晚我上楼后，还有谁上楼吗？你们有没有印象？”

酒馆老板一脸为难：“我们酒馆都会经营到深夜。二楼是客房，我们也不可能时刻注意谁上楼谁没上楼。”

“我们可以锁定时间。对方如果拿到的虫人骨灰就是昨晚那位的，那么他能拿到的时间只能在安德烈治安官把骨灰放到祭堂以后。”商非凡冷静分析。

治安官立刻道：“那时大约二十二点不到，应该在二十一点半到二十二点之间。对方如果拿到骨灰，再赶到酒馆，很可能已经二十二点过后。”

商非凡心想游戏商应该是为了方便，给游戏世界设定的时间和度量衡之类基本和现实世界等同。

酒馆老板努力回忆：“二十二点后来的客人是不多，让我想想。对了！老伯特就来得很迟，还有鼠多麦和卢西恩。其他人……我得再问问。”

治安官让酒馆老板询问时不要打草惊蛇。打算先去找老伯特三人询问情况。

商非凡却觉得这样问恐怕也问不出什么结果，因为如果是他，肯定会想到就这么一个小镇子，大家肯定都彼此认识，谁来酒馆谁没来，彼此互相询问下就能问出来。如果是外地人，那就更打眼。

想要造成不在场证明，最好的方法就是避开人眼。

对方很可能是带着东西从后墙爬到二楼，再从空客房的窗户里溜进来。

商非凡没有多说，他想看起来就很精明的治安官应该也想到了这点。只是查案子不可能想当然，需要把所有线索都过一遍，再繁琐也只能一步步查。

果然，治安官安德烈很快提出要查看其他空客房，包括卫浴间等。

酒馆老板当然不会反对。

一通检查下来，却没发现任何线索。

商非凡也跟着看了，同样没有发现异常。

凶手显然是个很谨慎的人。

“所以那些虫子跑到这位的房间，发出虫鸣，还死了这么多，就是一种诅咒仪式？”酒馆老板忍不住问要告辞离开的羊大婶。

羊大婶止住脚步：“应该就是这样。”

商非凡也好奇：“为什么虫子死亡时会念出诅咒的配方？”

“虫子不会专门去记住诅咒的配方，它们只是在重复死前看到闻到或者是驱使它们的东西。”羊大婶回答。

“那诅咒内容是什么？”商非凡又问。

羊大婶摇头：“这就不确定了。可惜不帅也没有听到。”

商非凡猜测治安官和这位羊大婶都知道虎不帅具有聆听者的天赋能力。

这事到此就这么不了了之。

如果诅咒者就是杀死那名虫人混血的凶手，那么他们原本就要找到这个人。

羊大婶建议商非凡把这些虫尸焚烧掉，虽然没有多大用处，但可以让诅咒不会那么快发作。

治安官帮忙把这些虫子连同床单一起拿到酒馆外面烧掉了。

这次商非凡终于注意到治安官的手指上戴着一个像是指套的东西，治安官点火时，那指套就像打火机一样冒出火焰。

治安官的指套，和羊大婶使用的小鼓，是不是就是虎不帅说的充当血脉天赋技能使用中介的炼金工具？

治安官十分同情商非凡，答应会帮助尽快找到凶手。但目前他们掌握的线索太少，只能先留意这段时间的外地来客。

除了酒馆，镇子里也住了一些外地人。治安官打算一一去寻访这些人。

“我要怎么驱除诅咒？总不能就这么等着诅咒降临。”商非凡拦住羊大婶。

作者有话说：

商非凡：就知道世上没有那么便宜的好事，果然不是神血血脉激发仪式。不过虎不帅为什么会主动插手这件事？
chunks.englishText:
The magistrate's expression turned unsightly. Before Shang Feifan could ask, he said, "Nobody usually goes to the town ancestral hall, and there aren't any important items kept there, so security isn't strict."

"Meaning anyone could walk in and get the insect-man ash," Shang Feifan noted.

The magistrate tacitly conceded this point.

Shang Feifan turned his gaze back to the tavern owner. "After I went upstairs last night, did anyone else go up? Do you have any recollection?"

The tavern owner looked troubled. "Our tavern stays open until late into the night. The second floor consists of guest rooms; there's no way we can constantly keep track of who goes upstairs and who doesn't."

"We can narrow down the time frame. If the culprit acquired the insect-man ash belonging to the one from last night, the earliest they could have gotten it would be after Magistrate Andrei placed the ashes in the ancestral hall," Shang Feifan analyzed calmly.

The magistrate immediately chimed in, "That was right around twenty-two hundred hours. It should have been between twenty-one-thirty and twenty-two hundred. If the culprit obtained the ashes and then hurried over to the tavern, it very well could have been past twenty-two hundred."

Shang Feifan mused that for the sake of convenience, the game developers must have set the time, measurements, and other basics of the game world to be virtually identical to the real world.

The tavern owner racked his brain, trying to remember. "Not many guests came in after twenty-two hundred—let me think. Ah! Old Robert came quite late, and then there were Rat-Many-Grains and Lucian. As for others... I'll have to ask around more."

The magistrate instructed the tavern owner not to startle the snake in the grass while making inquiries, planning instead to go question Old Robert and the other two first.

Yet, Shang Feifan felt that asking around like this probably wouldn't yield any results. After all, if he were the culprit, he would realize that in such a small town, everyone knew one another; inquiring among themselves would quickly reveal who came to the tavern and who didn't. If an outsider were involved, they would stand out even more.

The best way to establish an alibi was to avoid human eyes entirely.

The culprit had very likely carried the items, scaled the back wall to reach the second floor, and slipped in through the window of an unoccupied guest room.

Shang Feifan didn't say much more, figuring that the seemingly shrewd magistrate must have thought of this as well. However, investigating a case could not be based purely on guesswork; every single clue had to be vetted, and no matter how tedious, they could only investigate step by step.

Sure enough, Magistrate Andrei soon proposed inspecting the other empty guest rooms, including the washrooms.

Naturally, the tavern owner raised no objections.

After a thorough inspection, however, not a single clue was discovered.

Shang Feifan had tagged along to look as well, and likewise found nothing out of the ordinary.

Clearly, the murderer was an extremely cautious individual.

"So those bugs running into his room, making chirping sounds, and dying in such numbers—was that all part of a curse ritual?" The tavern owner couldn't help asking Auntie Yang, who was preparing to take her leave.

Auntie Yang halted her steps. "That should be the case."

Shang Feifan was also curious. "Why would bugs recite the recipe for a curse when they die?"

"Bugs don't go out of their way to memorize a curse's recipe; they are merely repeating what they saw, smelled, or what drove them just before death," Auntie Yang replied.

"Then what is the content of the curse?" Shang Feifan asked again.

Auntie Yang shook her head. "That isn't certain. It's a pity Bushuai didn't hear it."

Shang Feifan surmised that both the magistrate and Auntie Yang were aware of Hu Bushuai's innate ability as a Listener.

And so, the matter was left unsettled for the time being.

If the caster of the curse was indeed the murderer who had killed the half-breed insect-man, then they had to find this person regardless.

Auntie Yang advised Shang Feifan to burn the bug corpses. Although it wouldn't serve much practical use, it could at least prevent the curse from activating too quickly.

With the magistrate's help, the bugs were taken outside the tavern along with the bedsheet and burned.

This time, Shang Feifan finally noticed that the magistrate was wearing something like a finger-guard on his hand. When the magistrate lit the fire, that finger-guard sparked flames just like a cigarette lighter.

Were the magistrate's finger-guard and Auntie Yang's small drum the alchemical tools Hu Bushuai had mentioned, which acted as intermediaries to use bloodline talent skills?

Deeply sympathetic toward Shang Feifan, the magistrate promised to help find the murderer as quickly as possible. But the clues currently in their possession were far too scarce; for now, they could only keep a lookout for outsiders who had arrived recently.

Aside from the tavern, a few outsiders were lodging in the town as well. The magistrate intended to visit and interview each of them.

"How am I supposed to lift the curse? I can't just sit around waiting for it to befall me." Shang Feifan blocked Auntie Yang's path.

Author's Note:

Shang Feifan: I knew there was no such thing as a free lunch in this world; it really wasn't a divine blood awakening ritual. But why did Hu Bushuai take the initiative to meddle in this affair?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第7章 你要在这里常住？ (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第7章 你要在这里常住？

羊大婶眼含无奈：“抱歉，我没办法帮人驱除诅咒。我虽然是镇子上的祭司，但时至今日，绝大多数祭司已经只会做些装装样子的祭祀，我们的能力已经所剩无几，传承也基本断绝。也许其他地方还有天赋强大的祭司存在，但我……能做的事情真的不多。”

商非凡惊讶，没想到这位看起来十分普通的中年妇女竟然是祭司，还这么直接承认自己能力不高。

羊大婶再次说道：“抱歉。”

商非凡：“一点办法都没有吗？”

“如果你能找到对你下诅咒的人，也许对方有解除诅咒的方法。”

“但我不知道多久才能找到对方，而且就算找到那个凶手，对方也不一定愿意帮我解除诅咒。”商非凡摸出钱袋：“这是目前我能拿出的全部财产……”

羊大婶摆手：“你就算给我一万金达盾，我没办法还是没办法。”

“那么这个镇子或者附近，有没有有可能解决诅咒的人？”商非凡从来不知道什么叫死心。

羊大婶看虎兽人的眼睛，发现他的眼睛中没有丝毫惧怕和惶恐，反而很亮很亮，像是找到了某件特别好玩的事情。

“我真的不……”

“羊婶，”虎不帅走到羊大婶身边，握住她的手臂，轻轻摇了摇：“帮帮他。我们不能让一个会杀死虫人混血还会利用虫子诅咒他人的凶手留在镇子上，更不能让那个凶手继续得逞，谁也不知道那个凶手继续会做什么。”

羊大婶头疼：“你求我也没用，我是真的不知道如何解除这个诅咒，我对诅咒就不精通。我的能力只是读取种族和可能的血脉。”

这就是个很鸡肋的能力，用到的时候不多。她能当上祭司，只因为没人愿意当，另外就是祭司应该掌握的一些杂学知识她学得还可以。

“那这附近的村镇有对诅咒比较了解的人吗？”虎不帅眼含恳求。

羊大婶看看商非凡，又看向虎不帅，压低声音：“你又多管闲事。”

虎不帅：“我只是不想那个凶手得意。”

羊大婶眉头皱成疙瘩，犹豫了好一会儿才说道：“你们可以试试去找迪莉娅。她也许知道什么。”

“迪莉娅？”虎不帅听到这个名字似乎有点吃惊。

羊大婶轻轻点头：“就是她。原本她才应该成为镇子的祭司，但就因为她的疯病……”

“我知道了。”虎不帅神色有点沉重。

羊大婶：“你们找她帮忙的希望不大。还有不要说是我让你们去找她的。”

商非凡目送羊大婶离开，问虎不帅：“迪莉娅是谁？”

虎不帅也露出头疼神色：“她就是……镇长夫人。”

叮咚。

【任务八，想办法见到镇长夫人迪莉娅，从镇长夫人那里得到解除诅咒的方法。成功奖励贡献点5点。】

【任务九，找到诅咒你的凶手。奖励贡献点3点。】

商非凡数了数，九个任务，他已经完成了四个，获得3个贡献点。除去拓展地图的长期任务，他还有四个任务没有完成。

任务三和任务九很可能重复，找到杀死死者的凶手有可能就找到了诅咒他的人。

任务四的关键人物拉斐尔现在还不知道在哪里，他甚至有点怀疑拉斐尔就是那名凶手。

任务八，他现在就去。

“我想见到那位迪莉娅夫人，不帅你能帮忙吗？”商非凡觉得虎不帅这个名字取得有点古里古怪，哪有父母给自己孩子取名叫不帅的？

“我们不一定能见到她。”虎不帅为难地说。

“总要试试。帮帮我。”

虎不帅避开商非凡的目光，似乎在思考什么，过了一会儿轻轻点头：“好，我带你过去，但我不保证迪莉娅夫人愿意见你。”

“只要你能带我过去就行，能不能见到那位夫人，我自己想办法。”商非凡从虎不帅对镇长夫人的称呼中猜测他和镇长一家关系很一般。

镇长家位于镇子最南边，他也是镇子上唯一拥有一座农场的人。镇子上很多人都在镇长的农场里工作。

“镇长家拥有这里唯一一座农场，大家没有意见吗？”商非凡看虎不帅有点尴尬地走在一遍，就找了个话题。

虎不帅摇头：“这里就是镇长家先祖发展起来，那块农场一直属于他们家。这个镇子的镇民祖先不少都是镇长家先祖收留才会留在这里。”

“镇长位置是世袭？”

虎不帅再次摇头：“并不是。其实镇长他们家喜欢权力的家主并不多，许多任家主都只想经营好农场或做其他事情，他们并不愿担任镇子的镇长，就连镇子治安官、祭司和民兵团团长这三个职位也是他们建议推举出来，镇上有什么大事都会由四人共同商议决定。每一届这四个职位都是镇民共同投票，由票数最高的人担任。”

商非凡挑眉，心想怪不得治安官有底气说出“我们不会包庇任何一名凶手，不管他是谁”这样的话。

他对这个世界的背景越来越好奇。

“我看这里荒野很大，为什么大家不到荒野开辟田地？”

“因为这里不是所有土地都能种植农作物。这是一片受到诅咒的大地……”虎不帅低喃。

“诅咒？”商非凡发现这里诅咒真的很多，“能跟我多说一点吗？我发现我这方面的常识遗忘得很多。”

虎不帅无奈：“简单说，就是我们身处的大地绝大多数都受到了诅咒，只有被神祭司祝福过和被大量神血浇灌过的土壤才能重新种植农作物、果物和药草。

但神祭司已经越来越少，能觉醒神血的兽人也越来越少。相传镇长家那块农场之所以能种植，就是因为镇长先祖用大量神血浇灌，最后又献祭了自己的生命。

所以大家对这些能种植的土壤异常珍惜和在乎。可就算如此，仍旧避免不了诅咒降临，比如把虫人、虫人混血、虫族、虫族混血的尸体埋入大地，只要一个晚上就会导致那片土地以及附近土地都受到绝收甚至再也无法种植的诅咒。”

商非凡：“诅咒和虫族有关？”

“也不完全是。”虎不帅一副不知道该从何说起的模样：“你想要了解这些常识，我建议你去找祭司羊大婶，她管理着小镇图书室，那里有讲兽人世界历史和地理的书籍，还有些专供孩子们阅读的常识书。”

商非凡一听竟然还有图书室，心里感觉越发怪异，这哪里是个原始世界！

“祭司是不是也负责传授知识？”

“对。羊大婶负责教导镇上所有小孩子读书写字。这也是每个地方祭司的职责之一。”

商非凡换了个话题：“最近镇子上除了我以外，还有其他陌生人过来吗？”

虎不帅回忆：“莫约山谷镇北通河沟镇，南通金麦城，算是附近的交通要道，每天过往的外地人不算多，但也不少，大多数只是穿行而过，顶多留下来吃顿饭，只有少数人才会留下来。”

“最近一个月有多少外地人留下来？他们都住在什么地方？”商非凡一边走一边打量四周环境。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 7: You Plan to Live Here Permanently? (Part 1)

Auntie Yang’s eyes held helplessness. “I’m sorry, I have no way to help people dispel curses. Although I am the town’s priest, to this day, the vast majority of priests only know how to perform superficial rituals. Our abilities are almost non-existent, and our heritage is basically severed. Perhaps powerful, talented priests still exist elsewhere, but as for me... there really isn’t much I can do.”

Shang Feifan was surprised. He hadn’t expected this thoroughly ordinary middle-aged woman to actually be a priest, let alone admit her own lack of ability so directly.

Auntie Yang spoke again, “I am sorry.”

Shang Feifan asked, “Is there really no way at all?”

“If you can find the person who cursed you, perhaps they have a way to undo it.”

“But I don’t know how long it will take to find them. Besides, even if I find the culprit, they might not be willing to remove the curse for me.” Shang Feifan pulled out his coin pouch. “This is all the wealth I can pull together right now...”

Auntie Yang waved her hand. “Even if you gave me ten thousand Gold Dashilds, if I don’t have a way, I don’t have a way.”

“In that case, is there anyone in this town or nearby who might be able to resolve curses?” Shang Feifan had never been one to give up.

Auntie Yang looked into the tiger beastman’s eyes. She found that there was not a trace of fear or panic in his eyes; instead, they were exceptionally bright, as though he had stumbled upon something particularly fun.

“I really don’t...”

“Auntie Yang,” Hu Bushuai walked to Auntie Yang’s side, held her arm, and gently gave it a tug. “Help him. We can’t let a murderer who kills bug-human hybrids and uses bugs to curse others remain in our town. Even less can we allow that killer to keep having their way. No one knows what that killer will do next.”

Auntie Yang felt a headache coming on. “It’s useless to beg me. I truly do not know how to break this curse; I am not adept with curses at all. My ability is only reading race and potential bloodlines.”

This was a rather niche ability, rarely useful. The only reason she became a priest was because no one else was willing to do it, and she happened to be decent at the miscellaneous knowledge a priest ought to master.

“Then is there anyone in the neighboring villages or towns who knows more about curses?” Hu Bushuai asked pleadingly.

Auntie Yang looked at Shang Feifan, then at Hu Bushuai, and lowered her voice. “Meddling again.”

Hu Bushuai said, “I just don’t want that killer gloating.”

Auntie Yang’s brow furrowed into a deep knot. After hesitating for a good while, she said, “You two can try looking for Delia. She might know something.”

“Delia?” Hearing this name, Hu Bushuai seemed a bit startled.

Auntie Yang nodded gently. “That’s right, her. Originally, she was the one who should have become the town priest, but because of her madness...”

“I understand.” Hu Bushuai’s expression turned somewhat heavy.

Auntie Yang added, “There isn’t much hope in asking her for help. And don’t tell her that I sent you.”

Shang Feifan watched Auntie Yang leave, then asked Hu Bushuai, “Who is Delia?”

Hu Bushuai also showed a troubled look. “She is... the Mayor’s wife.”

*Ding-dong.*

[Quest 8: Find a way to meet the Mayor’s wife, Delia, and obtain a method to dispel the curse from her. Reward: 5 Contribution Points.]

[Quest 9: Find the killer who cursed you. Reward: 3 Contribution Points.]

Shang Feifan counted. Out of nine quests, he had already completed four, gaining 3 Contribution Points. Excluding the long-term map expansion quest, he still had four uncompleted quests.

Quest 3 and Quest 9 were very likely overlapping; finding the killer who murdered the deceased might lead to the person who cursed him.

The key figure for Quest 4, Raphael, was currently nowhere to be found. He even somewhat suspected Raphael was the murderer.

As for Quest 8, he would go right now.

“I want to meet this Madam Delia. Bushuai, can you help me?” Shang Feifan felt the name 'Hu Bushuai' (Tiger Not Handsome) was rather odd—what parents would name their child 'Not Handsome'?

“We might not be able to see her,” Hu Bushuai said awkwardly.

“We have to try at least. Help me out.”

Hu Bushuai avoided Shang Feifan’s gaze, seemingly mulling something over. After a moment, he gave a gentle nod. “Alright, I’ll take you over, but I can’t guarantee Madam Delia will be willing to see you.”

“As long as you can get me there, I’ll figure out a way to meet her myself.” Shang Feifan surmised from Hu Bushuai’s title for the Mayor’s wife that his relationship with the Mayor’s family was quite ordinary.

The Mayor’s house was located at the southernmost end of the town. He was also the only person in town who owned a farm. Many people in town worked on the Mayor’s farm.

“The Mayor’s family owns the only farm here. Doesn’t anyone object?” Shang Feifan noticed Hu Bushuai walking awkwardly beside him and brought up a topic.

Hu Bushuai shook his head. “This town was developed by the Mayor’s ancestors, and that farm has always belonged to his family. Many of the townspeople’s ancestors were only able to stay here because the Mayor’s ancestors took them in.”

“Is the Mayor’s position hereditary?”

Hu Bushuai shook his head again. “No, actually. Not many family heads in the Mayor’s lineage liked power. Many generations of family heads only wanted to run the farm well or pursue other interests; they weren’t keen on serving as town mayor. Even the three positions of Security Officer, Priest, and Militia Captain were nominated and created on their recommendation. Whenever something major happens in town, the four of them discuss and decide together. Every term, these four positions are voted on by the townspeople, and whoever gets the highest votes takes the post.”

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow, thinking to himself that it was no wonder the Security Officer had the confidence to say, “We will not shield any murderer, no matter who they are.”

He grew increasingly curious about the background of this world.

“I see that the wilderness here is vast. Why doesn’t everyone go into the wilderness to clear fields?”

“Because not all the land here can grow crops. This is a cursed land...” Hu Bushuai muttered softly.

“Cursed?” Shang Feifan realized there were truly a lot of curses in this place. “Can you tell me more? I’ve found that I’ve forgotten a lot of common knowledge in this regard.”

Hu Bushuai felt helpless. “To put it simply, the vast majority of the land we stand on is cursed. Only soil blessed by a Divine Priest or soaked with a massive amount of Divine Blood can be cultivated again with crops, fruits, and herbs.

“However, Divine Priests are becoming fewer and fewer, and beastmen capable of awakening Divine Blood are also getting rarer. Legend has it that the Mayor’s farm can be cultivated precisely because his ancestor drenched it with a vast amount of Divine Blood and ultimately sacrificed his own life.

“That’s why everyone cherishes and cares about this farmable soil immensely. But even so, it still can’t prevent curses from descending. For instance, if the corpse of a Bug-man, a Bug-man hybrid, a Bug-race, or a Bug-race hybrid is buried in the earth, in just one night, that piece of land and the surrounding soil will suffer a curse resulting in total crop failure or even complete infertility.”

Shang Feifan asked, “The curses are related to the Bug-race?”

“Not entirely.” Hu Bushuai looked as if he didn’t know where to begin. “If you want to learn this basic knowledge, I suggest you go to Auntie Yang. She manages the town library, which contains books on the history and geography of the beastman world, as well as common knowledge books meant for children.”

When Shang Feifan heard there was actually a library, he felt even weirder. How was this a primitive world at all!

“Are priests also responsible for imparting knowledge?”

“Yes. Auntie Yang is responsible for teaching all the kids in town to read and write. That’s also one of the duties of priests in every locality.”

Shang Feifan changed the topic, “Besides me, have any other strangers come to town recently?”

Hu Bushuai recalled, “Moyue Valley Town connects to Hegou Town in the north and Golden Wheat City in the south. It’s considered a major local thoroughfare. Not many outsiders pass through daily, but it’s not a small number either. Most just pass right through, at most staying for a meal. Only a few stay behind.”

“How many outsiders have stayed behind in the past month? Where are they living?” Shang Feifan asked, observing the surrounding environment as they walked.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第7章 你要在这里常住？ (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
他们走在一条不算直的长街上，街道两边都是石砖和石瓦建造的房屋，房屋造型都差不多，只大小略有差别。

以这条街道为中心，其他房屋都建在两排临街房后面。

这条街大概也是小镇的商业中心，一路走来，他看到了面包房、制衣店、皮具店、杂货店、蔬菜店、肉店、粮食店，甚至是武器店。

路上行人不算多，一些兽人小孩或人形或兽形的跑来跑去玩耍。

如果喜欢毛茸茸的，看到这些活泼可爱的小兽人，口水都得流满地。

听伏向军说有些玩家在新手村看到可爱的小兽人，抱住不放，结果就被小兽人的父母亲人取了第一滴血，死得特别冤。

他没接触过其他地方的兽人，但这里的人似乎比他预想得要冷漠一些，虽然有人会用看陌生人的好奇目光看他，也有认识虎不帅的人对他点头示意，但态度并不算亲热，更没有人上来跟他们搭话。

快要走到南边尽头时，他还看到了铁匠铺、石器铺、骨器铺，还有一家外面挂着炼金牌子的炼金店铺。

商非凡多看了几眼炼金店铺，猜测能不能在这里找到炼金师开启职业技能。

他看过游戏商城，里面也售卖职业技能和天赋技能，但哪怕是初级炼金术都需要一百贡献点才能买到，中级五百，高级一千，宗师级五千，还有一个神级炼金术需要十万贡献点。

天赋技能同样如此，最低价都要一百贡献点才能开启。

而他现在手上的贡献点才只有可怜的3点，积累到一百点还不知道要到什么时候。如果能通过NPC来开启职业技能，这贡献点不就不用花了吗？

不过换个方向思考，只要有贡献点就能学会这些土著兽人们需要觉醒血脉和特意去辛苦学习的技能，这绝对是超级挂！

虎不帅指着西边绵延的岩石山对商非凡说：“看到上面的风化洞了吗？那里有一些洞穴被收拾出来当做住房，租价很便宜，还有民兵巡逻，安全有一定保障，虽然不算舒适，但外地人如果想要在本镇常留，大多会住在那里。”

商非凡抬头，这才注意到那座岩石山上大量的风化洞，这些洞，他之前也看到了，但只以为是当地山景特色，没想到被当地人利用起来当做了住房。

“本地人很排斥外地人？”同样的问题，商非凡也问过治安官。

虎不帅摇头：“谈不上排斥，只是大家很不喜欢让陌生人住进自己家里，镇上也没有多余的空房子可以租卖给外地人。如果舍不得花钱住在酒馆二楼，就只能住到风洞山上。”

“外地人在本地要怎么赚钱生活？”

商非凡现在不得不考虑赚钱的问题，他身上钱币不多，酒馆住宿不贵，只要五十铜达铢一晚，但吃饭一顿就要一百二左右，他哪怕再节省，剩下的钱也只够他生活十天不到。

“你要在这里常住？”虎不帅神情有点怪异。

商非凡非常坦然地说：“诅咒的问题还没解决，我还承诺死者会帮他找到杀他的凶手，另外，我来这里也有点事要办，还不确定要花多长时间。而我身上的钱币已经不多。”

虎不帅了然：“那你擅长什么技能吗？”

我会制作武器，还会做炸-弹。商非凡：“我会手工制作一些工具。”

“那么你可以去铁匠铺、骨器铺，还有炼金店铺试试。不过炼金店铺的阿伯塔大师性格古怪，对学徒比较严厉，据说也不怎么给工钱。”虎不帅小小吐槽。

商非凡并不急着去攻略那位炼金大师，他对主动找罪受没兴趣。

“那我能自己开个工具铺或修理铺吗？”

“你要自己开店铺？”虎不帅看起来很吃惊。

“不可以？”

“不是不可以，但你打算把店铺开在哪里？还有启动资金哪里来？另外，镇民的需求基本饱和，你要卖什么工具才能赚到钱？修理的话，大家也有铁匠铺和骨器铺。”

“我还会修车。我看镇子上似乎还没有修车铺。我可以修理工具再兼职修车。”商非凡兴致勃勃。玩游戏怎么玩不是玩，他走休闲路线挺好的。

商非凡甚至向年轻兽人提出邀请：“你要和我合作吗？我正好缺个了解本地的助手。”

虎不帅眼睛都睁大了。
chunks.englishText:
They were walking down a long, not-quite-straight street. On both sides were houses built of stone bricks and stone tiles. The architecture was mostly similar, differing only slightly in size.

Centered around this street, other houses were built behind the two rows of street-facing buildings.

This street was likely the town’s commercial center. Walking along, he saw a bakery, a clothing shop, a leather goods shop, a general store, a vegetable shop, a butcher shop, a grain shop, and even a weapon shop.

There weren’t many pedestrians on the road. A few beastman children, in either human or beast form, were running about playing.

For anyone fond of fluffy creatures, seeing these lively, cute little beastmen would make them drool all over.

He had heard Fu Xiangjun mention that some players in starter villages saw cute little beastmen, hugged them tight, and ended up having their first blood drawn by the kids’ parents and relatives, dying a most tragic death.

He hadn’t interacted with beastmen from other places, but the people here seemed slightly colder than he had anticipated. Although some gave him curious glances as a stranger, and acquaintances of Hu Bushuai nodded to him in greeting, their attitude wasn’t warm, and no one came up to chat.

Near the southern end, he also saw a blacksmith shop, a stoneware shop, a bone-ware shop, and an alchemy shop with an alchemy sign hanging outside.

Shang Feifan took a few extra looks at the alchemy shop, wondering if he could find an alchemist here to unlock professional skills.

He had checked the game store, which also sold professional and talent skills, but even basic Alchemy required 100 Contribution Points to purchase, intermediate required 500, advanced 1,000, master 5,000, and a god-tier Alchemy required 100,000 Contribution Points.

The same applied to talent skills; even the lowest tier required 100 Contribution Points to unlock.

Yet right now, he only had a pitiful 3 Contribution Points on hand. Who knew how long it would take to accumulate 100 points? If he could unlock professional skills through NPCs, wouldn’t he save those Contribution Points?

Thinking about it from another angle, though—as long as one had Contribution Points, one could instantly master skills that native beastmen needed bloodline awakening or painstaking effort to learn. That was absolutely a super cheat!

Hu Bushuai pointed to the stretching rocky mountain to the west and said to Shang Feifan, “See those weathered caves up there? Some of those caves have been tidied up to serve as lodgings. The rent is very cheap, and militia patrol there, so security is somewhat guaranteed. Although not comfortable, if outsiders wish to stay long-term in town, most will live there.”

Shang Feifan looked up, only now noticing the numerous weathered caves on the rocky mountain. He had seen these caves earlier, but had assumed they were just a local scenic feature of the mountain, never imagining the locals utilized them as dwellings.

“Do the locals reject outsiders?” Shang Feifan had asked the Security Officer the same question.

Hu Bushuai shook his head. “It’s not really rejection. People just dislike letting strangers live in their homes, and there are no spare empty houses in town to rent or sell to outsiders. If you don’t want to spend money living on the second floor of the tavern, your only option is to stay on Wind Cave Mountain.”

“How do outsiders earn a living here?”

Shang Feifan was forced to consider the problem of earning money. He didn’t have many coins left. Tavern lodging wasn’t expensive—only fifty Copper Dashilds a night—but a single meal cost around one hundred twenty. No matter how frugal he was, his remaining money would only last him less than ten days.

“You plan to live here permanently?” Hu Bushuai’s expression turned slightly strange.

Shang Feifan said with total candor, “The curse issue hasn’t been resolved yet, and I promised the deceased I would help him find his killer. Besides, I have some business to handle here, and I’m not sure how long it will take. Meanwhile, I’m running low on coins.”

Hu Bushuai understood. “Then do you have any skills you are good at?”

*I know how to make weapons, and I can make bombs.* Shang Feifan said, “I can handcraft some tools.”

“In that case, you can try the blacksmith shop, the bone-ware shop, or the alchemy shop. Though Master Aborta at the alchemy shop has an eccentric personality, is quite strict with apprentices, and reportedly doesn’t pay much wages,” Hu Bushuai offered a minor complaint.

Shang Feifan was in no rush to work on that alchemy master; he had no interest in seeking out misery.

“Then can I open a tool shop or a repair shop myself?”

“You want to open a shop yourself?” Hu Bushuai looked astonished.

“Is that not allowed?”

“It’s not that it’s not allowed, but where do you plan to open it? And where will the startup capital come from? Besides, the townspeople’s needs are basically saturated. What tools could you sell to make money? As for repairs, everyone already has the blacksmith shop and bone-ware shop.”

“I can also repair carriages. I noticed there doesn’t seem to be a carriage repair shop in town. I can repair tools and take on carriage repairs as a side job.” Shang Feifan was full of enthusiasm. Playing a game was playing it however one wanted—taking a casual leisure route suited him just fine.

Shang Feifan even extended an invitation to the young beastman: “Want to partner with me? I just happen to need an assistant who knows the local area.”

Hu Bushuai’s eyes widened.

chunks.chineseText:
第8章 迪莉娅夫人

虎不帅毫不犹豫地婉拒了。

商非凡没感到失望，也没因为被拒绝就难堪。

他和虎不帅毕竟才认识一天不到，不说他来历不明，就说他身上还挂着一个没有解除的诅咒，就足以让人对他敬而远之。

虎不帅愿意帮他恳求羊大婶，还愿意陪他一起去找迪莉娅夫人，已经很有同情心和善意。

如果虎不帅真的很轻易就答应成为他的助手，他才要怀疑对方是不是在刻意接近他。

“镇长家就在前面，那栋最大的屋子。”虎不帅指向前方。

商非凡也看到了。

那是一栋非常显眼的大屋子，凹字形，占地约有两亩，只有一层，屋架很高，约有五六米，周围没有高树，空地全部被坚硬的石砖铺上。

在大屋子后面隐约可以看到大片田地，还有类似羊舍的建筑。

“这么大的房子就住了镇长夫妻两口子？”

虎不帅点头又摇头：“主人就他们两个。另外还有管家一家三口、厨娘一家四口，还有两户护卫和他们的孩子。”

商非凡：“那还差不多。否则这么大的房子就两个人住，我担心闹鬼。”

虎不帅嘴角动了动，似乎被逗笑。

“不过镇长把自己儿女转移出来，为什么还会允许管家等人的孩子留下？他就不担心管家他们的孩子被他夫人发疯伤害？那些护卫仆役也不担心自己的孩子吗？”

虎不帅称赞：“你很细心。”

虎不帅笑了下，“你不用担心管家他们的孩子，镇长会让他们留下，是因为他们的孩子都在十五岁以上，已经有了自保能力。而他和迪莉娅夫人的一双儿女，一个八岁，一个才五岁，没办法保护自己，他又没办法时时刻刻盯着，只能送走。”

“有那么多人看着也没办法保护好？”

“那是孩子的母亲，是镇长夫人。当一位母亲要和自己的孩子独处时，除了镇长本人，那栋宅子里的人谁又能阻止？再说镇长也不希望别人伤害到他夫人。”

商非凡点头，明白了迪莉娅夫人在镇长心目中的地位。

如果做丈夫的真的能狠下心，镇长夫人别说伤害自己的孩子，她连走出自己房门的可能性都没有。

虎不帅走到大宅的正门前敲门。

这里的前院就是开阔型的，没有花园大门，可以一直走到正宅大门口。

来开门的是管家的独生子，一个很爱笑的阳光男孩。

“日安，不帅少爷。”男孩说话的声音都有些跳跃。

商非凡：这个名字真的太古怪。为什么这些人的表情都这么正常？

“日安，达利尔。镇长在家吗？”

“镇长不在家，不过镇长说过，这是你的家，你想回来随时都能回来，快请进！啊，这位是？”

商非凡表情严肃：“诺曼霍希尔，我有点重要事情需要见到镇长或者迪莉娅夫人，与诅咒有关。”

“诅咒？！”达利尔大吃一惊：“可是镇长现在不在，也许您可以先去找治安官安德烈先生。”

“我已经找过他，他也没办法解决。迪莉娅夫人在家吗？听说夫人对诅咒有所了解，希望能见一面。”商非凡就没有给达利尔选择权。

“夫人不怎么太想见到外人，而且我也没听说她对诅咒有所了解……”达利尔为难地看向虎不帅。

虎不帅给了大男孩一个安慰的笑容：“迪莉娅夫人今天情况如何？”

“应该还可以。”达利尔不确定地说。

虎不帅出主意：“你去找你父亲，把这位先生来访的事情告诉他，让他去找镇长。然后问问他，可不可以让这位诺曼先生见见迪莉娅夫人。”

数分钟后，商非凡和虎不帅被请到了客厅。

管家科林差遣儿子去找镇长，自己留下来做陪客。

管家夫人玛琳在弄清楚客人的请求后，去请迪莉娅夫人。

科林和虎不帅低声说话，神态还算亲切。

商非凡暗中打量。从管家一家三口的态度来看，镇长对这个侄子还是有一定感情的？

管家科林从虎不帅那里大致了解了商非凡的情况，但是对商非凡能否见到夫人并不抱希望。

“他来自黑森林城？您是不是认识他？”管家低声问。

虎不帅神色微妙：“也许。”

管家声音压得更低：“他站在哪一边？”

虎不帅轻轻摇头，没有回答。

管家也不再询问，一名少女送来茶水点心。

虎不帅跟商非凡介绍，这是厨娘的大女儿。

过了一会儿，管家妻子玛琳回来。

“诺曼先生，不帅少爷，夫人请你们到花房。”

管家有一点惊讶，似乎没想到迪莉娅夫人愿意见外客。

两人跟着玛琳转移地点，来到位于大屋后面的花房。

不过这个花房和商非凡想的有点不一样，里面的花草植物并不多，倒是有很多台子，上面放了不少类似烧瓶和坩埚的工具，与其说是花房，不如说更像是一间巫女用来制作巫药的炼药室。

“这里用来种植花草的泥土都是从农场挖来的，需要经常更换，否则种在花盆里的植物就会莫名其妙枯萎。”

虎不帅看商非凡打量花房里的植物，特意跟他解说。

商非凡正要问虎不帅，迪莉娅夫人是不是懂得熬制巫药。

“你已经很久没来了。我这里是有刺吗？让你宁可住在酒馆，也不愿住在家里？”花房深处传来略微沙哑的女子声音。

商非凡和虎不帅一起看向抱着一个花盆走出来的女人。

这是一位五官深刻、肤色略深，穿着深红长裙，身材极佳，让人一眼看到就会惊艳的魅力型成熟-女性。

迪莉娅夫人抬手。

玛琳弯腰行礼，安静退下。

虎不帅略微尴尬地笑了笑：“不是的，我怕自己会打扰您。”

“你现在连一声小姨都不愿叫了吗？”迪莉娅夫人背对两人放下花盆。

虎不帅低头，小声喊：“小姨。”

商非凡：原来虎不帅不是镇长的侄子，是镇长夫人的外甥。但他们为什么要对外宣称他是镇长的侄子？外甥和侄子有什么差别？

迪莉娅夫人转身，目光没有看向虎不帅，而是投注到了商非凡身上。

“你确实中了诅咒。”迪莉娅夫人张口就道。

商非凡好奇：“您是从哪里看出这一点？”

“没有特征，但我看到就知道。”迪莉娅夫人的神态异常自信。

“是不是羊青青那个蠢货让你们来找我的？”

不等两人否认，迪莉娅夫人就说：“除了她，这个镇子上没人知道我对诅咒有所了解。她可真是会转移麻烦，和她祖母那个老东西一样让人讨厌！”

迪莉娅夫人突然又看向虎不帅：“你想救他？”

虎不帅：“如果您能帮他的话……”

迪莉娅夫人轻嗤：“你和你妈妈一样，就知道做好人，吃了那么多亏也没有记住教训。活该她被人占尽便宜，还被人像抹布一样给扔掉，你小心和她一样的下场。”

“小姨！”虎不帅重重喊了一声。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 8: Madam Delia (Part 1)

Hu Bushuai declined without hesitation.

Shang Feifan felt no disappointment, nor did he feel embarrassed by the rejection.

After all, he and Hu Bushuai had known each other for less than a day. Not only was his background unknown, but he also had an unremoved curse hanging over him—enough to make anyone keep their distance.

The fact that Hu Bushuai was willing to plead with Auntie Yang for him and accompany him to see Madam Delia already showed great compassion and goodwill.

If Hu Bushuai had readily agreed to become his assistant, Shang Feifan would instead suspect whether the guy was deliberately cozying up to him.

“The Mayor’s house is right up ahead—that biggest building,” Hu Bushuai pointed forward.

Shang Feifan saw it too.

It was a very conspicuous large building, shaped like a U-bracket, covering an area of roughly two mu. It had only one story, but the building frame was very tall, about five or six meters high. There were no tall trees nearby, and the open ground was entirely paved with hard stone bricks.

Behind the main building, expansive fields were faintly visible, along with structures resembling sheep folds.

“A house this big, and only the Mayor and his wife live here?”

Hu Bushuai nodded, then shook his head. “The masters are just the two of them. In addition, there’s the butler’s family of three, the cook’s family of four, plus two families of guards and their children.”

Shang Feifan commented, “That makes more sense. Otherwise, if only two people lived in a house this big, I’d worry about it being haunted.”

Hu Bushuai’s lips twitched, as if amused.

“However, since the Mayor relocated his own children, why would he still allow the children of the butler and others to stay? Isn’t he worried his wife might go crazy and hurt their children? Don’t those guards and servants worry about their own children either?”

Hu Bushuai praised, “You are very observant.”

Hu Bushuai smiled, “You don’t need to worry about the butler’s kids. The Mayor let them stay because their children are all over fifteen and already capable of self-defense. Meanwhile, his and Madam Delia’s pair of children—one is eight and the other is only five—have no way to protect themselves. And since he can’t keep watch every second, he could only send them away.”

“Even with so many people watching, they couldn’t keep them safe?”

“That is the children’s mother, the Mayor’s wife. When a mother wants to be alone with her children, who in that house besides the Mayor himself could stop her? Besides, the Mayor doesn’t want anyone hurting his wife either.”

Shang Feifan nodded, understanding Madam Delia’s position in the Mayor’s heart.

If the husband could truly harden his heart, let alone hurting her children, Madam Delia wouldn’t even have the chance to step outside her bedroom door.

Hu Bushuai walked up to the front entrance of the mansion and knocked.

The front courtyard here was open-style, without a garden gate, allowing one to walk straight up to the main mansion’s entrance.

The person who opened the door was the butler’s only son, a cheerful, sunshiny boy who loved to smile.

“Good day, Young Master Bushuai.” The boy’s voice carried a buoyant cadence.

Shang Feifan thought to himself: *This name really is too bizarre. Why do all these people look so normal using it?*

“Good day, Daryl. Is the Mayor home?”

“The Mayor isn’t home, but he said this is your home too, and you’re welcome to return whenever you like. Please, come in! Ah, who is this?”

Shang Feifan adopted a serious expression. “Norman Horshill. I have important business regarding a curse that requires meeting either the Mayor or Madam Delia.”

“A curse?!” Daryl was shocked. “But the Mayor isn’t here right now. Perhaps you could go see Security Officer Andre first.”

“I’ve already seen him, and he has no solution either. Is Madam Delia at home? I heard she has some knowledge regarding curses, so I hope to meet with her.” Shang Feifan left Daryl no room for refusal.

“Madam doesn’t really like meeting strangers, and I haven’t heard that she knows anything about curses...” Daryl looked awkwardly toward Hu Bushuai.

Hu Bushuai gave the big boy a reassuring smile. “How is Madam Delia’s condition today?”

“Should be fine,” Daryl said uncertainly.

Hu Bushuai offered a suggestion: “Go find your father, tell him about this gentleman’s visit, and have him fetch the Mayor. Then ask him if Mr. Norman here can see Madam Delia.”

A few minutes later, Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai were invited into the living room.

Colin the butler dispatched his son to fetch the Mayor while staying behind to entertain the guests.

Once the butler’s wife, Marlene, understood the guests’ request, she went to invite Madam Delia.

Colin and Hu Bushuai spoke in low voices, their demeanor quite friendly.

Shang Feifan observed surreptitiously. Judging from the attitude of the butler’s family, the Mayor seemed to harbor a fair amount of affection for this nephew.

Colin the butler gathered the general situation about Shang Feifan from Hu Bushuai, but held little hope that Shang Feifan could actually see the lady.

“He comes from Black Forest City? Do you know him?” the butler asked in a low voice.

Hu Bushuai’s expression turned nuanced. “Perhaps.”

The butler lowered his voice even further: “Which side is he on?”

Hu Bushuai shook his head softly without answering.

The butler asked no further questions. A young girl brought over tea and refreshments.

Hu Bushuai introduced to Shang Feifan that this was the cook’s eldest daughter.

A moment later, Marlene, the butler’s wife, returned.

“Mr. Norman, Young Master Bushuai, Madam invites you to the flower house.”

The butler was somewhat surprised; he hadn’t expected Madam Delia to actually agree to see outside guests.

The two followed Marlene to the flower house located behind the main mansion.

However, this flower house was a bit different from what Shang Feifan had envisioned. There weren’t many flowers or plants inside; instead, there were numerous counters laden with tools like flasks and cauldrons. Rather than a flower house, it resembled a potion lab used by a witch to craft brews.

“The soil used to grow plants here was dug up from the farm and needs to be replaced frequently. Otherwise, plants potted in it will mysteriously wither.”

Seeing Shang Feifan inspecting the plants in the flower house, Hu Bushuai specially explained to him.

Shang Feifan was just about to ask Hu Bushuai whether Madam Delia knew how to brew witch potions when—

“You haven’t come around in a long time. Does my place have thorns? So much so that you’d rather stay at a tavern than live at home?” A slightly raspy female voice echoed from deep within the flower house.

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai turned together toward a woman walking out while holding a flowerpot.

This was a mature woman of striking charm—deep facial features, slightly tan skin, dressed in a dark red gown, with a magnificent figure that would captivate anyone at first sight.

Madam Delia raised a hand.

Marlene bowed and quietly withdrew.

Hu Bushuai chuckled slightly awkwardly, “That’s not it. I was just afraid of disturbing you.”

“You’re not even willing to call me Aunt anymore?” Madam Delia turned her back to the two as she set down the flowerpot.

Hu Bushuai lowered his head and called softly, “Aunt.”

Shang Feifan thought: *So Hu Bushuai isn’t the Mayor’s nephew, but the Mayor’s wife’s nephew. But why do they claim publicly that he is the Mayor’s nephew? Is there any difference between a nephew on the father’s side versus the mother’s side?*

Madam Delia turned around. Her eyes didn’t land on Hu Bushuai, but fixed onto Shang Feifan.

“You are indeed cursed,” Madam Delia stated directly upon opening her mouth.

Shang Feifan asked curiously, “How can you tell?”

“There are no signs, but I know it the moment I look at you.” Madam Delia’s demeanor was exceptionally confident.

“Did that fool Yang Qingqing tell you two to look for me?”

Before either could deny it, Madam Delia snapped, “Besides her, no one in this town knows I have knowledge of curses. She sure knows how to pass the buck, just as insufferable as that old hag of a grandmother of hers!”

Madam Delia suddenly looked at Hu Bushuai again. “You want to save him?”

Hu Bushuai said, “If you can help him...”

Madam Delia sneered, “Just like your mother, you only know how to play the good person. You’ve suffered so many losses without learning a lesson. Serves her right for being taken advantage of and discarded like a rag. Watch out, or you’ll end up just like her!”

“Aunt!” Hu Bushuai shouted heavily.

迪莉娅夫人嘲笑：“他不是从黑森林城来的吗？你母亲和你那个贱人父亲的事，他会不知道？”

虎不帅眼中没有丝毫波动，他只是不高兴迪莉娅夫人侮辱他的母亲。父亲？那虫日的是谁？

不过很少有人能看出这点，大多数人都以为他很在意自己的身世，有些人还会故意用他的身世来伤害和刺激他，比如他这位小姨。

商非凡：很好，这位迪莉娅夫人非常有个性。他猜恐怕不是镇长让虎不帅出去住，而是虎不帅不愿意住在镇长家里。

商非凡也以为虎不帅被伤到了，拍拍虎不帅的肩膀，面对迪莉娅夫人：“我们谈正事吧。请问要如何解除我的诅咒？我应该付出什么样的代价？”

迪莉娅这才又看向商非凡，神色似笑非笑：“看在你是我这个傻瓜外甥亲自带来的份上，我确实可以帮你解除诅咒，不过我怕你付不出我想要的代价？”

商非凡：“您不妨说说看。”

迪莉娅纤长的手指虚空点了点：“我要虎王的心脏，你能给我取来吗？”

“小姨！”虎不帅的声音中含了一丝无奈和怒气。

商非凡非常现实地说：“我可能打不过他，甚至连接近都很难。”

更不要说他的玩家级别才一级，那位虎王……那可是虎王！商非凡怀疑他现在去看那位虎王的生命值和武力值，看到的很可能都是问号。

对了，这个游戏似乎无法直接看到NPC的血条，需要先学习鉴定术，或者是开启瞳术类天赋技能。

迪莉娅夫人低低笑起来：“好吧，这个条件对你们这些无能蠢货来说确实困难了一些。那就让我们换一个，这次如果还不行，我会让你们立刻知道诅咒应验是什么滋味。”

商非凡不确定地问：“您的意思是，当您提出条件，我必须答应？”

“对！我的时间可不是给你们随便浪费的。”迪莉娅夫人跟故意逗弄虎不帅一样，看向他，柔声说：“看在我好外甥的份上，我给你们三秒的犹豫时间。现在你们还有机会不听我的条件，直接走出花房大门。三、二、一！”

商非凡没有动，虎不帅也就没有动。

迪莉娅夫人目光扫过两人，突然就像是失去了兴趣一样，意兴阑珊地说：“到莫约山谷，为我取得一颗至少百年以上的不腐尸的心脏。另外要三只成年独角虫犀的角，以及黑骨山活着的骨虫九十九只。”

叮咚。

【任务十，接受迪莉娅夫人的条件，为她寻来一颗至少百年以上莫约山谷出土的不腐尸心脏，三只成年独角虫犀的角，以及九十九只黑骨山活骨虫。成功奖励贡献点十点，同时奖励开启鉴定师职业技能之初级鉴定术。】

真是想什么来什么，为了开启初级鉴定术，他也得接下这个任务。

商非凡：从偷听到不帅和管家的一点对话来看，不帅有可能认识我？还是他听过诺曼霍希尔这个名字？

Lady Delia sneered. "Didn't he come from Black Forest City? How could he not know about your mother and that bastard father of yours?"

Not a single ripple flickered in Hu Bushuai's eyes. He was merely displeased that Lady Delia had insulted his mother. His father? Who gave a damn about that bug-fucker anyway?

However, very few people could discern this about him. Most assumed he cared deeply about his parentage, and some would deliberately use his background to hurt and provoke him—much like this aunt of his.

Shang Feifan thought to himself: *Great, Lady Delia certainly has a strong personality.* He guessed it wasn't the Mayor who had forced Hu Bushuai to move out, but rather Hu Bushuai who was unwilling to stay in the Mayor's house.

Assuming Hu Bushuai had been hurt by her words, Shang Feifan patted his shoulder and turned to face Lady Delia. "Let's talk business. May I ask how my curse can be lifted? What price must I pay?"

Delia finally turned her gaze back to Shang Feifan, her expression half-smiling and half-mocking. "Seeing as my foolish nephew brought you here himself, I indeed *can* help you lift the curse. However... I'm afraid you won't be able to pay the price I demand."

"You might as well name it, my lady," Shang Feifan said.

Delia tapped her slender fingers against the empty air. "I want the heart of the Tiger King. Can you fetch it for me?"

"Aunt!" A trace of helplessness and anger crept into Hu Bushuai's voice.

Shang Feifan spoke with blunt realism. "I probably can't defeat him. I doubt I could even get close."

Not to mention his player level was only Level 1, while that Tiger King... was the frigging Tiger King! Shang Feifan suspected that if he tried to inspect the Tiger King's health and combat power right now, all he would see were question marks.

Right, this game didn't seem to allow players to view an NPC's health bar directly. One needed to learn the Appraisal skill first or unlock an Ocular Talent skill.

Lady Delia let out a low chuckle. "Well, that condition is indeed a bit too difficult for useless fools like you. Then let's change it to another. But if this still won't do, I will make you both realize immediately what the curse coming to pass feels like."

Shang Feifan asked uncertainly, "Do you mean that once you state your condition, I have no choice but to accept?"

"Correct! My time isn't meant to be squandered by the likes of you." Delia looked at Hu Bushuai as if teasing him on purpose, her voice softening. "For the sake of my dear nephew, I'll give you three seconds to hesitate. Right now, you still have the chance to leave through the glasshouse doors without hearing my condition. Three, two, one!"

Shang Feifan didn't move, and so Hu Bushuai didn't move either.

Lady Delia swept her gaze over the two of them. Suddenly, as though she had lost all interest, she said listlessly, "Go to Moyue Valley and retrieve the heart of an uncorrupted corpse at least a century old for me. In addition, I want the horns of three adult Monoceros Bug-Rhinos, and ninety-nine living bone-bugs from Black Bone Mountain."

*Ding-dong.*

[Quest 10: Accept Lady Delia's conditions. Retrieve for her the heart of an uncorrupted corpse unearthed in Moyue Valley that is at least a century old, the horns of three adult Monoceros Bug-Rhinos, and ninety-nine living bone-bugs from Black Bone Mountain. Reward upon success: 10 Contribution Points, along with unlocking the Appraiser professional skill: Elementary Appraisal.]

Ask and you shall receive. In order to unlock Elementary Appraisal, he had to take this quest no matter what.

***

**Author's Note:**

*Shang Feifan: Judging from the conversation I overheard between Bushuai and the butler, could Bushuai know me? Or has he heard the name Norman Horshir before?*

第9章 巨虫坐骑

两人被管家送出大门时，遇到了带着护卫和达利尔赶回来的镇长。

镇长一看到虎不帅就从坐骑上跳下来，快步走向虎不帅。

商非凡眼睛盯住坐骑。

镇长和他两个护卫的坐骑竟然不是兽形，而是……三只巨大的虫子？

虫子身体狭长，有六只细长腿，下颚尖锐，颚下有两只锋利的小爪子，额头还有触须。

这三只虫子要放到地球就是超级怪物，但在这里它们却充当着被驯化的坐骑。

虎不帅停住脚步，对镇长叫了一声：“姨父。”

“很好，我还以为你要叫镇长先生。”镇长长得很帅，有着成熟男人特有的魅力，和迪莉娅夫人很配。

但商非凡还是看出来镇长的年龄应该比迪莉娅夫人大了很多，他的身体也许还很健壮，但他眼角眉梢的皱纹是被岁月刻下的深刻。

“这位就是来自黑森林城的诺曼霍希尔先生了吧？”镇长转看向商非凡。

商非凡还没有弄清楚这里的礼仪，只能对镇长微微点头：“日安，镇长先生。”

“你身上有着战火与鲜血的味道。你是虎族战士？”镇长的目光没有安德烈锐利，但有着安德烈治安官没有的阅历和智慧。

商非凡没有回答是与不是，只是笑笑。

镇长却像是理解一样，对商非凡不算很冷淡地说：“叫我狼叔就好。”

镇长一顿：“你们见到我夫人了吗？”

虎不帅代为回答：“见到了。”

“哦？”镇长对自家外甥的态度就自然多了，“她嘴巴上虽然不说，但她很想念你，你来看她，她怎么都会见你一面。”

“她今天看起来很好。”虎不帅说。

镇长露出笑容：“是的，她这几天精神状态维持得很好，我觉得她已经在好转。你知道，她没有什么疯病，她只是一直无法从失去我们第三个孩子的悲痛中走出来，正好那时候你母亲也去世，她一下子失去两个亲人……”

虎不帅勉强拉扯嘴角，强行转移话题：“小姨答应帮助霍希尔先生，不过给出了一定条件。”

镇长了然地拍拍虎不帅的肩膀，顺着他说：“什么条件？”

虎不帅就把迪莉娅夫人的要求说了。

镇长挑挑眉：“除了黑骨山的骨虫，其他两个可都不容易达成，尤其是进入莫约山谷寻找百年以上的不腐尸。我想你们……霍希尔先生应该很需要一名向导，我会让安德烈帮霍希尔先生找一名熟悉本地的向导。不帅你留下来，我有点事要你帮忙。”

商非凡一下就听出来这位镇长并不想他的外甥和他这个被诅咒的陌生人搅合在一起，故意找了个借口想要分开他们两人。

不过这才是亲人的态度不是吗？

虎不帅显然也听出来了：“我已经答应霍希尔先生做他的向导。”

商非凡：不，你没答应。我就没提过这件事。

当虎不帅看向他时，商非凡对镇长露出歉意笑容：“是的，我雇佣了不帅帮忙，他已经答应了。”

商非凡还没有自信到虎不帅和他相处一天就对他产生好感，进而想要帮他帮到底。他猜，虎不帅接近他，很可能有其他目的。

镇长当着商非凡的面就把外甥拉到了一边。

“他被诅咒了。”

“我知道。”

“他还是个外地人，来自黑森林城的外地人。他很可能知道你的身份。”最后一句话，镇长声音压得很低。

“就算知道又怎样？我已经离开王都。黑森林城虽然是王都的附城，但也不是谁都会留意到我这个小人物。更不会有人特意追到这里来找我麻烦。”虎不帅的说话声音同样很低。

“有些人可不会因为你离开王都就放过你。对他们来说，你当着他们的面死掉、再当着他们的面烧成灰烬，他们才会真正放心。”

“姨父……”

镇长抬手，表示这个话题到此为止：“总之，我不相信那家伙，他还是虎兽人。”

虎不帅心里有自己的打算，但有些事他又不好和他罹患亲人焦虑症的姨父说明，只好：“如果他真的是为我而来，我躲着也没用。还不如接近他，看看他想干什么。您知道我的能力，只要他有一点疏忽，都可能在我面前泄露他的秘密。”

“他很可能知道你的能力。”

“他不会知道的很全面。”

镇长看虎不帅。

虎不帅给了他一个“相信我”的眼神。

镇长头疼：“你们家的血脉是不是都有固执的毛病，你小姨是这样、你母亲是这样，你也是这样。”

虎不帅上前一步，拥抱了下爱操心的镇长姨父。

镇长抬起手臂，拍了拍便宜外甥的肩背，又轻轻推开他，松口：

“你可以给那家伙做向导，不过我也有一个条件，让狼四跟着你们，不允许拒绝。”

虎不帅看出来这是镇长最后的让步，只能同意。

商非凡虽然更喜欢自己单独行动，但有两个熟悉本地的当地人做免费向导，他自然也不会拒绝，他也想快点完成任务。

镇长顺口邀请商非凡和自己外甥一起住到他的大宅里。

商非凡婉拒。这位镇长先生就不是诚心邀请他，只是为了外甥想把他放到自己眼皮子底下便于监视而已。

虽然这是一个很好的接近本地最高权威的机会，但……还是等他接到攻略镇长或镇长一家的任务再说。

虎不帅直接摇头，表示他住在酒馆二楼就挺好。

镇长拿这个外甥也挺无奈，但他也知道他妻子和这个外甥的关系有点复杂，两人明明都很关心彼此，却无法说到一块去。

就算迪莉娅是他妻子，他也不得不说，他夫人的性格，真不是一般人能吃得消。

镇长和另一名护卫以及达利尔回转大宅，叫做狼四的护卫和他的坐骑一起留下。

没多久，达利尔又牵出两匹巨虫坐骑交给虎不帅和商非凡。

“镇长说，这只是借用。这里距离莫约山谷还有些距离，他想狼四叔早点回来。”

虎不帅知道这是姨父怕他拒绝才这么说。

商非凡更清楚镇长愿意借出坐骑和护卫，都是担心外甥。

想到这里，他心中产生了一丝特别怪异的感觉。这个游戏世界里的NPC也未免太智能，什么样的AI系统可以创造出如此多模拟真人思考和行为的智能NPC？简直就像是一群活人在本色演出。

达利尔对虎不帅挤挤眼睛，小声说：“镇长和夫人都很担心您，镇长当着夫人的面把你骂了一通，说你不懂事不听话，还不关心自己的姨父和姨母。夫人生气了，让我爸吩咐厨房晚上只做鼠兔肉。”

虎不帅眼中漾起笑意：“等我从莫约山谷回来，我会回来吃饭。到时候把狼杀和飞影也接回来。”

“不帅少爷，那我们就这么说定了！”达利尔异常高兴，蹦跶着跑回大屋想要告诉镇长这个好消息。

狼四牵着坐骑走近两人，右手握拳轻敲左胸，同时低头，向虎不帅行礼。

“不帅少爷，我们是现在就出发去莫约山谷吗？”
chunks.englishText:
# Chapter 9: Giant Bug Mounts (Part 1)

As the butler escorted the two out the front gate, they ran into the Town Mayor returning with his guards and Daryl.

The moment the Mayor spotted Hu Bushuai, he dismounted and strode over to him.

Shang Feifan's eyes locked onto the mounts.

The mounts of the Mayor and his two guards weren't beasts at all, but... three giant insects?

The insects had long, narrow bodies, six thin legs, sharp mandibles with two tiny, razor-sharp claws beneath them, and long antennae on their foreheads.

If these three bugs were placed on Earth, they would be considered terrifying monsters. Yet here, they served as domesticated mounts.

Hu Bushuai stopped in his tracks and greeted the Mayor, "Uncle."

"Good. I thought you were going to call me Mr. Mayor." The Mayor was quite handsome, possessing the mature charm unique to older men—a fine match for Lady Delia.

Still, Shang Feifan could tell the Mayor was likely much older than Lady Delia. Though his body was still robust, the wrinkles around the corners of his eyes and brows were deep marks etched by time.

"This must be Mr. Norman Horshir from Black Forest City, yes?" The Mayor turned to look at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan hadn't figured out the local etiquette yet, so he could only offer a polite nod. "Good day, Mr. Mayor."

"You carry the scent of warfire and blood upon you. Are you a Tiger warrior?" The Mayor's gaze wasn't as sharp as Andre's, but it possessed an experienced wisdom that Sheriff Andre lacked.

Shang Feifan neither confirmed nor denied it, offering only a smile.

Taking it as tacit confirmation, the Mayor spoke in a tone that wasn't overly cold: "Just call me Uncle Wolf."

The Mayor paused before asking, "Did you see my wife?"

Hu Bushuai answered on his behalf. "We did."

"Oh?" The Mayor's attitude toward his own nephew was far more natural. "She might not say it out loud, but she misses you dearly. Since you came to visit, she would grant you an audience no matter what."

"She seemed to be doing well today," Hu Bushuai said.

A smile appeared on the Mayor's face. "Yes, her mental state has been quite stable these past few days. I feel she's already improving. You know, she doesn't suffer from any madness. She simply hasn't been able to walk out of the grief of losing our third child. It just so happened that your mother passed away around the same time, so she lost two loved ones all at once..."

Hu Bushuai forced a slight twitch of his lips, deliberately switching the topic. "Aunt agreed to help Mr. Horshir, though she set a few conditions."

The Mayor patted Hu Bushuai's shoulder knowingly and went along with the subject. "What conditions?"

Hu Bushuai related Lady Delia's demands.

The Mayor raised an eyebrow. "Aside from the bone-bugs of Black Bone Mountain, the other two won't be easy to accomplish—especially entering Moyue Valley to search for a century-old uncorrupted corpse. I imagine you... Mr. Horshir must be in dire need of a guide. I'll have Andre help Mr. Horshir find a local who knows the area well. Bushuai, you stay behind. I have something I need your help with."

Shang Feifan could tell immediately that the Mayor didn't want his nephew mixing with a cursed stranger like him, intentionally using an excuse to separate them.

Then again, that was how a real family member would react, wasn't it?

Hu Bushuai had clearly realized this as well. "I've already agreed to serve as Mr. Horshir's guide."

Shang Feifan thought: *No, you didn't. I never even brought that up.*

When Hu Bushuai glanced over at him, Shang Feifan offered the Mayor an apologetic smile. "Indeed, I hired Bushuai for his help, and he has already agreed."

Shang Feifan was not arrogant enough to think Hu Bushuai had developed a liking for him after spending just one day together and wanted to help him to the end. He guessed that Hu Bushuai likely had another motive for staying close to him.

Right in front of Shang Feifan, the Mayor pulled his nephew to the side.

"He's cursed."

"I know."

"He's an outsider too—an outsider from Black Forest City. He very likely knows your true identity." The Mayor lowered his voice significantly on that last sentence.

"So what if he does? I've already left the Capital. While Black Forest City is a satellite city to the Capital, not just anyone would pay attention to a nobody like me. No one's going to chase me all the way out here to cause trouble," Hu Bushuai replied, his voice equally hushed.

"Some people won't let you off just because you left the Capital. To them, only when you die right before their eyes and burn into ashes will they truly rest easy."

"Uncle..."

The Mayor raised a hand, indicating the topic was closed. "In short, I don't trust that fellow. He's a Tiger beastman to boot."

Hu Bushuai had his own plans, but there were things he couldn't easily explain to his uncle, who suffered from severe family anxiety. He could only say, "If he really came for me, hiding won't do any good. It's better to stay close to him and see what he's up to. You know my ability—as long as he slips up even a little, he'll spill his secrets right in front of me."

"He might very well know about your ability."

"He won't know the full scope of it."

The Mayor stared at Hu Bushuai.

Hu Bushuai gave him a look that said, *Trust me.*

The Mayor felt a headache coming on. "Is stubbornness a hereditary trait in your family? Your aunt is like this, your mother was like this, and you're the exact same."

Hu Bushuai took a step forward and embraced his worrying uncle.

The Mayor raised his arms, patted his nephew's back, then gently pushed him away, relenting at last.

"You may act as his guide, but I have one condition as well. Wolf Four must go with you, and I won't take no for an answer."

Hu Bushuai could see that this was the Mayor's final compromise, so he had no choice but to agree.

Although Shang Feifan preferred acting alone, he naturally wouldn't refuse having two locals serve as free guides. Besides, he wanted to finish the quest as quickly as possible.

The Mayor casually invited Shang Feifan to stay in his mansion along with his nephew.

Shang Feifan politely declined. The Mayor wasn't sincerely inviting him; he just wanted to keep an eye on him for his nephew's sake.

While this was a great opportunity to get close to the highest local authority, he would wait until he received a quest to gain favor with the Mayor or the Mayor's family before pursuing it.

Hu Bushuai shook his head directly, stating that staying on the second floor of the tavern suited him just fine.

The Mayor was quite helpless when it came to his nephew. However, he also knew that the relationship between his wife and nephew was complicated. Both clearly cared about each other, yet they could never hold a proper conversation without clashing.

Even though Delia was his wife, he had to admit that her temperament was not something an ordinary person could stomach.

The Mayor, along with his other guard and Daryl, turned back toward the main house, leaving behind the guard named Wolf Four and his mount.

A short while later, Daryl led two more giant bug mounts out and handed them to Hu Bushuai and Shang Feifan.

"The Mayor says these are just loans. It's still a bit of a distance from here to Moyue Valley, and he wants Uncle Wolf Four to return as soon as possible."

Hu Bushuai knew his uncle had put it that way only because he was afraid he would refuse.

Shang Feifan understood even better that the Mayor was willing to lend the mounts and guard solely out of concern for his nephew.

Thinking up to this point, a strangely peculiar feeling arose in his heart. The NPCs in this game world were absurdly intelligent. What kind of AI system could create so many intelligent NPCs capable of simulating human thought and behavior so realistically? It felt almost as if a group of real people were acting as themselves.

Daryl winked at Hu Bushuai and whispered, "The Mayor and the Madam were both very worried about you. The Mayor even scolded you in front of Madam, saying you were foolish and disobedient, and didn't care about your uncle and aunt. Madam got angry and told my dad to order the kitchen to serve only pika meat for dinner."

A smile rippled through Hu Bushuai's eyes. "When I return from Moyue Valley, I'll come back for dinner. I'll bring Wolf Kill and Flying Shadow back with me then."

"Young Master Bushuai, it's a deal then!" Daryl was overjoyed, bounding back toward the main house to report the good news to the Mayor.

Wolf Four walked over to the two men holding his mount's reins. He pressed his right fist against the left side of his chest, bowing his head in a formal salute to Hu Bushuai.

"Young Master Bushuai, shall we head out to Moyue Valley right now?"

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡插话：“之前我就想问，这里不就是莫约山谷镇吗？为什么你们提到莫约山谷就像是另一个地方，还是一个很危险的地方？”

商非凡还想问为什么你们的姓名有偏东方风的、也有偏西方风的，但想到这也许是游戏设定，也不想虎不帅怀疑他常识到底缺乏到什么程度，就没多问。

虎不帅伸手介绍护卫狼四：“我来这里其实也没有多久，对于本地，狼四叔比我知道的更清楚，接下来他将负责向导之职，你有什么事都可以请教他。”

狼四对商非凡轻点头，很自然地就接过解说工作：“外地人第一次来我们这里确实很容易迷糊。我们这里的山谷很长，整体说，山谷前头三分之二细长，后面三分之一空间比较大，就像一个细长颈大肚瓶。我们镇子就在这个大肚子中。而我们通常说的莫约山谷指的是和镇子断开的前面细长处。”

虎不帅补充：“这还涉及到一个传说。”

传说莫约山谷在过去很危险，兽人们无法在山谷中居住。

但有一个狼兽人家庭迁徙到附近，偶尔发现这里有一片土地可以种植农作物，于是这家狼兽人决定留下来。

这个狼兽人家庭就是虎不帅的姨父的先祖。

这位先祖觉醒了神血血脉，拥有非常强大的能力。为了让家人和寻求庇护的兽人能在这里安全生活，他使用神血能力劈开了山谷两边的大山，让莫约山谷镇的部分和前面的山谷彻底分离。

“当然，这只是传说。我姨父说家里根本没有留下这样的说法，但镇子上的人都爱这么传。”

“那是大家对建立镇子的先祖家主的爱的表达。”狼四笑：“我们已经习惯叫前面细长端的山谷为莫约山谷，称我们这一段为莫约镇。山谷里面很危险。”

“霍希尔先生来我镇的时候看到镇外那条土路了吧？那条土路虽然也通往莫约山谷，但在尽头有分岔，本地人和外地人会从山谷外面的平原绕行，也就是从风洞山的西面平原穿越。虽然这会绕远路，但要比直接穿过山谷安全得多。”

“路上我再跟您详细介绍吧。我们最好不要在山谷里面过夜。”狼四翻身一跃，跳到巨虫坐骑的背上，抓起缰绳。

虎不帅招呼商非凡，也跟着跳上巨虫坐骑。

商非凡……不想表现出他没见过世面的乡下人模样，但他觉得自己恐怕无法原地起跳两米直接跳到巨虫背上。

要用爬的吗？好像有点丢脸。

叮咚。

【任务十一，请骑乘巨虫坐骑成功奔行五百米。达成后奖励可任选其一：开启驯虫师初级职业技能，或，奖励不限定坐骑类别的初级骑乘术。】

【任务十二，请深入查探莫约山谷，达成后奖励贡献点2点。】

不就五百米吗？干了！

商非凡仔细回想虎不帅和狼四的动作，靠近巨虫坐骑，原地跃起。

跳不起来他再爬。

艹！他小瞧这具兽人身体的弹跳性了。

用力过头，他跳得超过了巨虫坐骑的背高，超出很多。

商非凡无视尴尬现场，空中收腹拧腰，动作潇洒地翻了个跟头，稳稳落在巨虫背上。

尴尬是什么？已经被他吃了。

狼四：呵，虎兽人！无时不刻都不忘耍帅。

虎不帅：……这人是不是忘了怎么操纵巨虫坐骑？要提醒他吗？巨虫可不是那么好操纵的。

商非凡抓起缰绳，淡定脸：他骑过马，不怂。

一声口哨，三只虫兽一起冲了出去。

作者有话说：

商非凡：端着。
chunks.englishText:
# Chapter 9: Giant Bug Mounts (Part 2)

Shang Feifan interjected, "I wanted to ask earlier... Isn't this town called Moyue Valley Town? Why do you refer to Moyue Valley as if it's a completely different—and very dangerous—place?"

Shang Feifan also wanted to ask why some of their names sounded distinctly Eastern while others sounded Western, but realizing it might just be part of the game setting, and not wanting Hu Bushuai to suspect how severely lacking his common knowledge was, he refrained from asking.

Hu Bushuai raised a hand to introduce the guard, Wolf Four. "I haven't been here for very long myself. When it comes to the local geography, Uncle Wolf Four knows it much better than I do. He'll be acting as our guide from here on, so feel free to ask him if you have any questions."

Wolf Four gave Shang Feifan a slight nod and naturally took over the explanation. "It's quite common for outsiders visiting for the first time to get confused. The valley here is extremely long. Overall, the front two-thirds is narrow and long, while the back one-third expands into a wider space, much like a narrow-necked bottle with a large belly. Our town sits right inside this large belly, whereas what we usually refer to as 'Moyue Valley' refers to the long, narrow section in front that is separated from the town."

Hu Bushuai added, "This actually ties into a local legend."

Legend had it that Moyue Valley used to be extremely dangerous, making it impossible for beastmen to dwell within it.

However, a family of Wolf beastmen migrated nearby and happened to discover a patch of fertile land suitable for growing crops. Thus, the Wolf beastman family decided to settle down.

That Wolf beastman family was the ancestor of Hu Bushuai's uncle.

That ancestor had awakened the Divine Blood lineage, possessing immense power. To allow his family and the beastmen seeking refuge to live safely here, he used his Divine Blood abilities to cleave apart the massive mountains on both sides of the valley, completely separating Moyue Valley Town from the valley ahead.

"Of course, that's just a legend. My uncle says no such story was ever handed down in the family, but the townsfolk love spreading it anyway."

"It's just the villagers' way of expressing their love for the ancestral patriarch who founded the town," Wolf Four said with a chuckle. "We've grown used to calling the narrow front end Moyue Valley, and referring to our section as Moyue Town. The interior of the valley is quite perilous."

"Mr. Horshir, you saw the dirt road outside the town when you arrived, right? Although that dirt road leads toward Moyue Valley as well, it forks at the end. Locals and outsiders usually travel around the plains outside the valley, crossing through the western plains of Wind Cave Mountain. Although it takes a longer detour, it's far safer than cutting straight through the valley."

"I'll give you a more detailed explanation on the way. It's best if we don't spend the night inside the valley." Wolf Four leaped in a swift motion onto the back of his giant bug mount and grabbed the reins.

Hu Bushuai motioned to Shang Feifan and likewise leaped onto his own giant bug mount.

Shang Feifan... didn't want to look like an ignorant bumpkin who had never seen the world, but he felt he probably couldn't jump two meters straight up onto the back of a giant insect.

Was he supposed to crawl up? That felt a bit embarrassing.

*Ding-dong.*

[Quest 11: Ride a giant bug mount and ride continuously for five hundred meters. Reward upon completion (Choose one): Unlock Bug Tamer professional skill: Elementary Bug Taming, OR, unlock Elementary Riding Skill (Unrestricted mount type).]

[Quest 12: Investigate deep into Moyue Valley. Reward upon completion: 2 Contribution Points.]

*It's just five hundred meters, isn't it? Let's do this!*

Recalling the movements of Hu Bushuai and Wolf Four, Shang Feifan approached the giant bug mount and sprang upward from his spot.

If he couldn't jump high enough, he'd just climb the rest of the way.

*Fuck!* He had severely underestimated the jump power of this beastman body.

Using too much strength, he leaped way past the height of the giant bug's back—overshooting by a wide margin.

Ignoring the awkwardness of the situation, Shang Feifan tucked his abdomen and twisted his waist mid-air, executing a dashing flip before landing solidly on the giant bug's back.

What awkwardness? He'd already swallowed it whole.

Wolf Four thought: *Heh, Tiger beastmen! Never missing a chance to show off.*

Hu Bushuai thought: *...Did this guy forget how to control a giant bug mount? Should I remind him? Giant bugs aren't that easy to handle.*

Shang Feifan grabbed the reins with a cool, composure-filled face: He had ridden horses before. He wasn't scared.

With a whistle, the three beast insects charged forward together.

***

**Author's Note:**

*Shang Feifan: Keep up appearances at all costs.*

chunks.chapterTitle: 第10章 信中的莫约山谷 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第10章 信中的莫约山谷

商非凡从来不知道虫子能跑出这么快的速度！

而且它们不是在街道上奔跑，它们竟然从房顶上、屋檐边、装饰物上跳跃着前行！

而且它们还不都是正着跳，它们竟然能贴着墙面斜着蹦跶！

试过身体横过来与地面一百八十度平行快速奔跑吗？

试过脚朝上脑袋朝下跳跃奔跑吗？

这一刻，老商无比感谢自己一上来就拉住了缰绳，否则这会儿他的脸已经和大地亲密接触。

操控这些巨虫坐骑显然是一门学问，他试着放松或拉紧缰绳，但也不知道哪里惹怒了他的巨虫坐骑，导致这只大虫子怒火高升，奔跑跳跃的姿势越发奔放自由。

商非凡懂它，这虫子就想甩掉他，甚至想干掉他。

他现在也想干掉这只大虫子！

路上有那么多大小兽人，狼四和虎不帅就在前面。老商坚持不叫停，他非要坚持五百米不可！

虎不帅几次回头，见诺曼霍希尔虽然几次身体与虫背脱离飞起，但他始终牢牢握住缰绳，没有被巨虫甩下来，也就不再担心他。

任何人想要学会骑巨虫，都得经历这一段。

有些经验需要自己亲身尝试才能学会，别人教是教不会的。

最重要的是那个虎兽人没有向他们求助，他可能只是遗忘了怎么操纵巨虫坐骑，现在正趁机利用身体记忆来回忆这个技能？

只不过那只巨虫是不是不太喜欢那个虎兽人，跳得特别疯……

紧张刺激的奔跑中，五百米很快就擦过去。

叮咚。

【恭喜玩家顺利完成任务十一。请在以下两个选项中选择你想要的奖励……】

商非凡是个现实主义者，他毫不犹豫地选择：“初级骑乘术！”

【玩家获得奖励“不限坐骑种类的初级骑乘术”。玩家已经学会初级骑乘术，想要更好地掌握骑乘术，请多多进行实际操练。】

商非凡不知道游戏是怎么操控的，但游戏系统宣布他已经学会初级骑乘术后，他的身体和大脑突然就有了一股玄妙的感觉，就好像他曾经多次骑过巨虫。

他的身体肌肉下意识调整，手中缰绳也像是要知道该用什么力道以及什么时候该给出什么样的信号。

他这时才知道想要很好地操纵巨虫，和巨虫那两根长触角互动也很重要。

当巨虫的长触角伸向你时，其实是在询问你的意见。

你得通过手指碰触触角的节奏和拨弄触角方向，来告诉巨虫你想要它怎么跑、往哪个方向跑、跑快还是跑慢。

还有，骑乘巨虫时，根据巨虫种类不同，有些部位不能随意碰触。比如他正骑着的这只巨虫就不能用脚踢打它的腹部。

而刚才他把巨虫当马骑，几次用双脚脚跟敲击它的腹部。怪不得巨虫火大……

狼四骑乘巨虫的节奏慢下来，靠近虎不帅。

“那位霍希尔先生学得很快。”

虎不帅：“他被人攻击过脑袋，遗忘了一些常识记忆。”

“我说他怎么有点奇怪。”狼四恍然大悟。

“现在应该是他的身体帮他回忆起如何骑乘巨虫。”

“也是，身体记忆要比大脑记忆更牢固。前面就是混乱区，我们是从外面绕，还是从里面穿行？”狼四询问意见。

虎不帅望向前方：“从里面穿行。”

狼四没有问为什么，直接遵从命令。

家主跟他们说过，除了他和夫人，家里就不帅少爷最大，比小少爷小小姐的排位还要在前面。

商非凡总算学会了如何骑乘巨虫，从后面追了上来。

看两人放慢速度，他也跟着放慢速度。

“前面是混乱区，要小心提防。”虎不帅靠近商非凡，叮嘱。

“混乱区？”

商非凡很快就看到了混乱区。

他先看到了一个巨大的石头堆砌的围墙，围墙中间有一扇像是用骨头编织起来的骨头大门。

此时，骨头大门敞开了一半，可以供人和车辆坐骑进出。

大门边和围墙上有人巡逻。

巡逻兽人看到他们三人，目光中有警惕有兴奋，还有隐隐的妒忌和仇视。

“这里是？”

“有人认为他们也是莫约山谷镇人，但我们从没有承认过。”狼四看混乱区的目光很冷，同样带着仇视，还带了一些鄙视。

商非凡等着他继续解说。

狼四收到虎不帅的目光示意，就进一步说明道：“这里生活的大多数都是一群无赖和混蛋。这里的兽人部分是在我们镇犯错被我们镇驱逐出去的罪人，他们不愿离开镇子，就在镇子附近住下，他们故意选择堵在和我们镇北出口相对的莫约山谷细长端的南端谷口，就是想给我们添堵。

因为这里聚集了一群混蛋，附近村落被驱逐的罪人也逐渐集中到这里，还有一些游荡兽人，总之都是一些不正经兽人，他们在这里搞聚集地，死赖着不肯走。我们又不能真的打杀他们、烧光他们的屋子。毕竟这里面还有不少孩子，也有一些活不下去逃到这里的无辜兽人。”

一开始，那些无赖就靠那些孩子向当时的镇长求情，当时的镇长一时心软，就默认了他们在这里生活。

结果……就这么留成了毒瘤，如今真打起来，他们镇也得付出不少代价。

狼四提到这个混乱区，就恨得牙痒。

商非凡对这种情况可是太了解，现实中有无数类似的事情。

“他们也不敢太过得罪镇子和附近村落，太过分的事不敢做，至少不敢跑出来打家劫舍。莫约山谷虽然危险，但也是一个资源比较丰富的地方。这些人就靠进山谷和在附近山脉以及荒野探索找材料，靠那些找到的材料和附近人交换粮食和生存物资来生活。”虎不帅的态度要中立得多。

“但里面因为管理不行，确实很混乱。进去后，如果有人和你搭讪，最好不要理睬。”虎不帅给出警告。

商非凡跟在两人身后进入敞开的骨头大门，一进去就感觉到和莫约镇截然不同的气氛和环境。

首先是空气质量。

非常古怪，刚才在大门外，他抬头看到的还是蓝天，但进入这里后，看到的就是灰蒙蒙的天空。

天空在骨头大门的围墙处画出了一道分界线，一边阴霾一边晴。

这里的空气闻着都带着一股臭味和砂土味。

其次是房屋和道路。

这里房屋搭建混乱没有规划，大多数房屋虽然也是石造，但不是整齐的石砖，而是用碎石和泥堆砌，看着就像是危房。还有用毛皮和骨架搭建的简易房屋。

路边看不到下水道系统，住民随手就把家里的垃圾和粪便倾倒在路面上。

没有笔直的道路，只有在棚户中穿行的蜿蜒小路。小路全都是土路。

再就是人。

苍蝇蚊虫围着垃圾和兽人们飞舞，幼小不懂事的兽人仍在街上追跑打闹，但不管是人形还是兽形，全都脏兮兮像是很久没有人给他们洗澡洗衣服。

没穿衣服的小兽人，倒在路边的醉汉……
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 10: The Moyue Valley Mentioned in the Letter

Shang Feifan had never imagined that bugs could run with such terrifying speed!

Furthermore, they weren’t just running along the streets—they were leaping forward across rooftops, eaves, and architectural decorations!

To make matters worse, they didn't just jump right-side up; they could scuttle sideways, clinging flat against vertical walls!

Have you ever tried running rapidly with your body positioned entirely horizontally, one hundred and eighty degrees parallel to the ground?

Have you ever tried jumping and sprinting with your feet facing the sky and your head pointing at the earth?

At this very moment, old Shang was infinitely grateful that he had grabbed the reins right from the start; otherwise, his face would have already had a passionate, intimate embrace with the ground.

Controlling these giant insect mounts was clearly a profound art. He tried loosening or tightening the reins, but somewhere along the way, he must have offended his giant bug mount, causing its anger to flare and driving its running and leaping posture to become increasingly uninhibited and wild.

Shang Feifan understood the creature; this bug simply wanted to shake him off, or perhaps even kill him outright.

Right now, he wanted to kill this giant bug just as badly!

There were so many beastmen of all sizes on the road ahead, with Wolf Four and Hu Bushuai leading the way. Old Shang stubbornly refused to call for a halt—he was dead set on enduring this for five hundred meters!

Hu Bushuai turned his head back a few times. Seeing that Norman Horsiel, despite having his body dislodge and fly off the bug's back several times, was still gripping the reins with a death-grip and hadn't been thrown off, he stopped worrying about him.

Anyone wanting to learn how to ride a giant bug had to go through this initial phase.

Some experiences had to be learned through firsthand trial; other people simply couldn't teach them to you.

The most important thing was that this tiger beastman hadn't asked them for help. Perhaps he had simply forgotten how to pilot a giant insect mount and was now taking the opportunity to use his muscle memory to recover the skill?

Only... did that giant bug perhaps dislike that tiger beastman a little bit? It was jumping around with such extraordinary madness...

Amidst the thrilling and nerve-wracking sprint, the five-hundred-meter mark slipped by in a flash.

*Ding-dong.*

[Congratulations to the player for successfully completing Quest Eleven. Please choose your desired reward from the following two options...]

Shang Feifan was a pragmatist. Without a single moment of hesitation, he chose: "Basic Riding!"

[The player has obtained the reward: "Mount-Agnostic Basic Riding." The player has learned Basic Riding. To better master the riding skill, please engage in more practical drills.]

Shang Feifan didn't know how the game operated, but the moment the game system announced that he had learned Basic Riding, a mysterious, marvelous sensation suddenly flooded his body and mind, as if he had ridden giant bugs numerous times before.

His muscle tissue unconsciously adjusted itself, and the reins in his hands suddenly seemed to understand exactly what force to apply and when to send out specific signals.

Only then did he realize that to properly maneuver a giant bug, interacting with its two long antennae was also crucial.

When a giant bug extended its long antennae toward you, it was actually asking for your opinion.

You had to use the rhythm of your fingers tapping against the antennae and the direction you nudged them to tell the giant bug how you wanted it to run, which direction to head, and whether to run fast or slow.

Furthermore, when riding a giant bug, depending on its species, certain parts could not be touched casually. For instance, the giant bug he was currently riding strictly forbade having its belly kicked or struck with heels.

Yet, just moments ago, he had treated the giant bug like an ordinary horse, repeatedly hammering its abdomen with both heels. No wonder the bug was furious...

Wolf Four slowed down the pace of his giant bug, drawing closer to Hu Bushuai.

"That Mr. Horsiel is learning remarkably fast."

Hu Bushuai replied, "He suffered a head injury and lost some of his basic memories."

"No wonder he seemed a bit strange," Wolf Four said, suddenly enlightened.

"Right now, his physical body should be helping him recall how to ride a giant bug."

"True, muscle memory is always sturdier than brain memory. Ahead is the Chaotic Zone; should we bypass it from the outside or ride straight through the middle?" Wolf Four asked for his opinion.

Hu Bushuai gazed forward. "Ride straight through the middle."

Wolf Four didn't ask why; he simply obeyed the command.

The head of the family had told them that aside from him and the madam, Young Master Bushuai held the highest authority in the household—ranking even higher than the young masters and young misses.

Shang Feifan had finally learned how to ride a giant bug, and he chased after them from behind.

Seeing the two of them slow down, he followed suit and reduced his speed as well.

"Ahead lies the Chaotic Zone. Keep your guard up," Hu Bushuai warned as he drew closer to Shang Feifan.

"The Chaotic Zone?"

Shang Feifan soon laid eyes on the Chaotic Zone.

First, he saw a massive wall constructed of piled boulders, in the middle of which stood a bone gate that looked as though it had been woven from actual bones.

At this moment, the bone gate was half-open, allowing people, vehicles, and mounts to pass through.

Guards were patrolling both beside the gate and along the top of the stone wall.

When the patrolling beastmen caught sight of the three of them, their gazes flickered with a mix of vigilance, excitement, and a lingering undercurrent of jealousy and hostility.

"What is this place?"

"Some people believe they are also residents of Moyue Valley Town, but we have never acknowledged them." Wolf Four’s gaze toward the Chaotic Zone was ice-cold, carrying the same hostility along with a heavy dose of contempt.

Shang Feifan waited for him to elaborate.

Receiving a subtle visual cue from Hu Bushuai, Wolf Four explained further: "Most of the people living here are a bunch of scoundrels and bastards. A portion of the beastmen here are criminals who committed offenses in our town and were subsequently expelled. Unwilling to leave the vicinity, they settled down right outside the town. They deliberately chose to camp at the southern mouth of the narrow northern end of Moyue Valley—right opposite our town's northern exit—just to be a constant thorn in our side.

Because a crowd of scoundrels gathered here, expelled criminals from nearby villages also gradually concentrated in this area, along with various wandering beastmen. In short, they’re all disreputable types. They set up this settlement and stubbornly refuse to leave. Yet we can't simply slaughter them all or burn down their homes—after all, there are still quite a few children living in there, alongside some innocent beastmen who fled here with no other way to survive."
