He had assumed the civilization level of this world roughly resembled Earth's Middle Ages, so what in the world was he looking at right now?

He was actually gazing upon a modernized metropolis filled with towering skyscrapers.

Though this metropolis had been thoroughly destroyed, every single skyscraper had been reduced to broken walls and ruined pillars.

He even spotted a ring-shaped elevated railway track suspended mid-air, though most of it was shattered and broken.

He also saw a massive statue that might have once served as a landmark building.

The head of that statue had half of its skull shaved off, one of its arms was broken, and its torso was completely webbed with deep cracks.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第31章 学徒级诅咒祭司 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
但那座雕像是如此显目，它的高度超过了剩下的所有城市建筑的高度，你不管从哪个方向看，都能一眼看到这座雕像。

那座雕像还剩下的半个头颅有一只空洞的眼睛，它的眼珠是雕刻出来的，也不知经过怎样的设计，让你不管从哪个方向看，都会觉得那只眼睛在看着你。

空洞、漠然的眼神。

又似乎充满极度的愤怒和不甘。

商非凡的脑中听到了无数呐喊声、惨叫声、愤怒的嚎叫声、婴儿的啼哭声……

声音刺耳，不，是刺激得他脑神经都要崩溃。

老商的眼睛、耳朵开始流出血丝。

吧嗒，失魂的小貂和骨鞭落到地上。

商非凡跟着身体晃动，痛苦地抱住脑袋，缓缓跪到地上。

猛地，商非凡的右眼视界弹出了几行文字。

这几行文字就跟强行插-入的病毒式营销软件一样，非常具有存在感地跳到了人类大脑接收信号的最前面。

【警告！警告！有外来精神力正在入侵，信徒精神力防护墙被攻击。请信徒立刻加固精神力防护墙。】

【信徒精神力损伤，精神力-1、-1、-1……】

【请信徒立刻呼唤至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯之名，请祂降下庇佑！】

商非凡抱头单膝跪地，他的大脑要爆炸了！

当他接收到这个可以帮助他的信号时，他已经没有足够的理智去分析这样做的利弊，他的潜意识在抵抗去呼唤那什么诅咒之神-的名字，可他混乱的大脑已经先一步有了动作。

他不想就这么死掉，就这么下线。

似乎本能让他知道就这么死亡下线，也许比他寻求某个诅咒之神的庇佑更糟糕。

他不能把……带回去……

把什么带回去？

商非凡想要细想，更多更多刺耳的声音挤爆了他的听觉神经。一股可怕的力量从听觉神经开始疯狂摧毁他的其他神经。

商非凡发出了凄厉的吼叫，疼得满地打滚。

“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯，请听信徒的呼唤，降下您的庇佑……”

“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯，请听信徒的呼唤，降下您的庇佑……”

“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯，请听信徒的呼唤，降下您的庇佑……”

商非凡不知道自己无意识地祈求了多少遍。

右眼视界在跳动着几行古怪的符号，他想看清楚，但意识逐渐模糊。

脑中疯狂的惨叫怒吼所有世间负面的声音消失了。

另一个遥远空旷、深深如雷、威严冷酷，却又充满神秘感的声音在他脑中响起。

【献上你的身与魂，成为吾之虔诚信徒。】

【献上你的意志与忠诚，成为吾威名与力量的传播者。】

【与吾契约，你将成为黑暗中的行走者，怨念的集结体，你将成为万众之敌，你将为吾建立永恒国度，只要诅咒不消，你将永远存在。】

商非凡：我他妈有多蠢才会和这种黑暗大boss搅到一起？

“同意！吾神，我现在就是你最虔诚的信徒了，要定契约吗？”

不过就是来头大了点、诡异了一点的甲方，祂想当老大，那就让祂当好了。

那雷声震震的神秘声音突然消失，似乎没想到这个看似难缠的寄主会这么干脆利落。

商非凡摇摇晃晃地从地上爬起来。

【……契成。】

商非凡挑眉，他隐隐感觉到自己似乎和什么东西联系到了一起。

但那又怎样呢？

人生嘛，没有一点冒险精神，那还有什么乐子可言？

看，他刚刚与“魔鬼”契约，就有返利出现了。

右眼视界跳出新的提示：

【信徒得到至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯的庇佑，精神力防护墙被修复被加固，精神力+1、+1、+1……】

【恭喜信徒精神力突破到33/100！】

看这个买卖多划算，才刚签下合约，他的精神力就翻了两倍还多。

他就喜欢这种大方的合作商！

商非凡特意查看了脑载系统中的个人信息，他的精神力值果然同步更新。

另外他的神血天赋也出现了第二个：诅咒之力，9/100。

另另外，他的职业技能也新增加了一个：诅咒祭司，学徒级。

有点微妙的是，他的个人属性中-出现了一个新的属性：幸运值，0。

对他的幸运值，老商很淡定。

他的工作让他经常和不同的酋长接触，而众所周知——近墨者黑。

商非凡比较在意的是，他的脑载系统并不排斥诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯的契约，换句话说，这两者很可能早就勾搭在一起，说不定还有什么不可言说的PY交易。

商非凡想到这里，失笑。明明就是个游戏，这十成就是一个游戏设定，他是不是想太多了？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 31: Apprentice-Grade Curse Priest (Part 2)

Yet that statue remained strikingly conspicuous, its height surpassing all the remaining urban architecture. No matter which direction you looked from, you could spot this statue at a single glance.

The remaining half-head of the statue possessed a hollow eye. Its eyeball was carved, and through some unknown design, no matter what angle you viewed it from, it felt as though that single eye was staring directly at you.

An empty, indifferent gaze.

Yet it also seemed fraught with extreme rage and lingering resentment.

Within Shang Feifan’s mind echoed countless shouts, miserable shrieks, furious howls, and the crying of infants...

The sounds were ear-piercing—no, they were so piercingly shrill that his cranial nerves felt on the verge of collapse.

Old Shang’s eyes and ears began to bleed micro-filaments of red.

*Plop.* The soul-drained little sable and the bone whip fell to the ground.

Shang Feifan swayed in tandem, clutching his head in agony as he slowly sank to his knees.

Abruptly, several lines of text popped up within the visual field of his right eye.

These lines of text, much like a forcefully inserted viral marketing software, thrust themselves with unignorable prominence right to the forefront of the human brain's signal-receiving center.

[Warning! Warning! External mental energy is currently invading, believer's mental energy defense wall is under attack. Believer is requested to reinforce the mental energy defense wall immediately.]

[Believer's mental energy damaged, Mental Energy -1, -1, -1...]

[Believer is requested to immediately invoke the supreme and magnificent existence, the name of the God of Curses, Curniceus, and beseech His descent of divine protection!]

Shang Feifan hugged his head and dropped to one knee; his brain felt as though it was about to explode!

By the time he received this signal offering salvation, he no longer possessed sufficient rationality to analyze the pros and cons of doing so. His subconscious resisted uttering the name of that so-called God of Curses, but his chaotic mind had already taken action a step ahead.

He didn't want to die just like this, to log off like this.

Instinct seemed to tell him that perishing and logging off right now might be even worse than seeking the protection of some God of Curses.

He couldn't bring... back...

Bring what back?

Shang Feifan wanted to ponder further, but more and more screeching noises crowded out his auditory nerves. A terrifying force began to frantically devastate his remaining nerves, starting from his auditory pathways.

Shang Feifan let out a shrieking howl, rolling all over the ground in agonizing pain.

"Supreme and magnificent existence, God of Curses Curniceus, please hear the call of your believer, and bestow your divine protection..."

"Supreme and magnificent existence, God of Curses Curniceus, please hear the call of your believer, and bestow your divine protection..."

"Supreme and magnificent existence, God of Curses Curniceus, please hear the call of your believer, and bestow your divine protection..."

Shang Feifan had no idea how many times he had unconsciously chanted the prayer.

Weird symbols flickered within his right-eye vision; he wanted to see them clearly, but his consciousness was gradually blurring.

The frantic shrieks and furious roars echoing in his mind—all the negative sounds of this world—vanished.

Another distant, hollow, deep as thunder, majestic yet cold, yet brimming with mystical resonance, voice echoed in his mind.

[Offer your body and soul, and become My devout believer.]

[Offer your will and loyalty, and become the spreader of My mighty name and power.]

[Contract with Me, and you shall become the walker in darkness, the convergence of lingering resentments. You shall become the enemy of the masses, and you shall build an eternal kingdom for Me. As long as curses endure, you shall exist forever.]

Shang Feifan: Just how fucking stupid am I to get mixed up with this kind of dark final boss?

"Agreed! My God, I am now your most devout believer. Shall we seal the contract?"

So what if His backing was a bit grander and creepier than usual? Since He wanted to play boss, he'd let Him be the boss.

That thunderous, mysterious voice abruptly cut off, as if it hadn't expected this seemingly tricky host to agree with such crisp and unhesitating decisiveness.

Shang Feifan climbed shakily to his feet.

[...Contract formed.]

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow; he vaguely sensed that he had established a connection with something.

So what if he had?

Life, after all, lacked any flavor if one didn't have a bit of adventurous spirit, right?

Look, no sooner had he contracted with the "devil" than dividends had already appeared.

A new prompt popped up in his right-eye vision:

[Believer has obtained the protection of the supreme and magnificent existence, the God of Curses Curniceus. Mental energy defense wall repaired and reinforced, Mental Energy +1, +1, +1...]

[Congratulations to believer, mental energy has broken through to 33/100!]

Look at how cost-effective this trade was; no sooner had he signed the contract than his mental energy had more than doubled.

He just loved this kind of generous business partner!

Shang Feifan deliberately checked his personal information within the brain-embedded system, and his mental energy value had indeed updated synchronously.

In addition, his second Divine Blood talent had also manifested: Power of the Curse, 9/100.

What was more, a brand-new professional skill had been added: Curse Priest, Apprentice Grade.

Somewhat subtly, a new attribute had appeared in his personal status panel: Luck Value, 0.

Regarding his luck value, Old Shang remained entirely calm.

His line of work frequently brought him into contact with various chieftains, and as the saying went—he who touches pitch shall be defiled.

What Shang Feifan cared about more was that his brain-embedded system showed no repulsion toward the contract with the God of Curses Curniceus. In other words, these two had very likely hooked up long ago, and perhaps even engaged in some indescribable, unspeakable PY transactions.

At this thought, Shang Feifan couldn't help but chuckle. It was clearly just a game; ten to one it was just a game mechanic, was he overthinking things?

chunks.chineseText:
第32章 主线任务

“阿城，醒醒……”

商非凡提起明明睁着眼睛、却没有多少反应的小貂晃了又晃，还拍了拍他的脸颊，也没能让他清醒过来。

还好小貂体型小，长度只有一条胳膊那么长，提着就能走。

商非凡希望游戏系统或者他的右眼能给他一点提醒，比如告诉他这里是哪里，要怎么离开这里，但两者全都是沉默状态，什么提示也没有。

商非凡又打开游戏地图，可惜他的游戏地图只能显示已经探索过的地方……

嗯？未知区域一和未知区域二，这是什么意思？

商非凡干脆放大地图，把他已经在游戏里记录过的地图全都放了出来，并缩小再缩小，试图看到地图全貌。

随后，商非凡就为自己这个举动点赞了。

他看到了这个世界的形状，一颗像是被虫子咬了两口的正圆形球体。

这颗被咬的星球名字叫天河星。

他探索过的地方都在球形体中标注了出来。

就是这幅地图比较鸡贼，不肯把海洋、陆地和岛屿标注出来，只在一片空白上点了几个黑点，附上名字，表示这是他曾经探索过的地方。

但根据黑点落脚的位置，再看整体的球形地图以及经纬线后，他大致可以推算出他曾经探索过的地方应该都位于天河星的北半球，在北极和赤道之间，更靠近北极，属于温带气候。

而天河星被咬出来的两个缺口，一处就位于北半球，距离他探索过的地图有相当遥远的距离。还有一处则位于南半球靠近赤道的地方。

但未知区域一和未知区域二竟然都没有落点在地图上！

这两个特别标注为红点的区域悬浮在地图上空，就好像空中城市。

而且地图上特别为两个未知区域标明了一句话：坐标无法探查。

这不就是说这两个未知区域很可能处于另一个空间？

两个未知区域是否处于另一个空间这点，商非凡并不是很在意，游戏嘛，还不是想怎么设定就怎么设定，它哪怕把整个世界都整成多重重叠空间，他也不会奇怪。

他高兴和想要点赞的是，他现在知道天残谷到强盗窝到莫约山谷镇的具体方向了，甚至能计算出大致距离。

前面他真的是忽略这个地图功能太多！

说不定游戏系统中还有其他有用功能，还没有被他发现和挖掘出来。

商非凡就站在原地，仔细查看起游戏系统的各项功能。

他以前就认真分析过这个系统，但现在他看得更细致，并试图找出各个项目的隐藏功能。

废墟城市很安静，似乎也没有什么危险。

大概是商非凡表现得太-安逸、太没有上进心，系统终于忍不住了，给他发布了一个新任务。

【任务二十三，请探索面前的废墟城市，探索程度每增加百分之十，奖励1点贡献点。】

商非凡隐去笑容，抬头。

商人都知道做生意要抢占先机，但一定不能太急。有时候迂回更能达到目的，比的就是谁更沉得住气、谁更急着想要达成目的。

在不知道离开方法前，他原本就需要探索这座城市，但现在他将有至少1点最多10点贡献点入账。

商非凡的眼睛再次和那座雕像的眼睛对上。

无数疯狂的痛苦的凄厉的哭喊怒吼也再次蜂拥而至。

但可能拥有诅咒之神庇佑的缘故吧，这些声音再也无法伤害他的脑神经，就像是隔了很多重过滤。

可那只空洞的又像是充满各种极端情绪的眼睛仍旧对他充满吸引力，让他不由自主就要抬脚向雕像坐落的城市中心走去。

挪开目光！

商非凡在脑中对自己下令，用最大意志力迫使自己转头，让自己的眼睛脱离那雕像眼睛的注视。

没有成功。

他的意识很清醒，他知道自己被雕像的眼睛诱惑，可他还是不由自主地往雕像的方向走。

老商讨厌自己像傀儡一样被未知存在操控，但他同时又好奇那雕像非要诱惑他过去的目的是什么。

就这么矛盾着，商非凡逐渐靠近雕像。

小貂阿城被他落在原地。

距离越近，他就看得越清楚。这座雕像从身躯到脸孔都看不出明显的性别特征，身上穿着原始战甲，你既可以说它是女性，也可以把它看为是男性。胸大也可以是胸肌！

他感觉自己走了很久，两腿肌肉和脚底板都有了熟悉的酸涩感。

他甚至还感到了饥饿和干渴。

但他一路都没有分心，甚至没有往脚下和路两旁多瞧一眼，就这么径直走到了雕像跟前。

这座雕像没有基石，它的双脚直接落在地面上。

商非凡仰头看着雕像，靠近雕像的他还没有雕像的一根脚趾高。

这么看，虽然不能看清雕像的全貌，但能更清晰地看到它身上密密麻麻的裂纹，就好像随时随地都会裂开，变成一地碎石。

可怜的雕像，近看才发现它缺失的部分更多。

比如他面前的脚趾就少了一根小拇指。

商非凡抬起手，宛如被蛊惑一般，手掌高高抬起，落到了雕像的……脚背上。

这是他最后的倔强。

狂乱的声音陡然变大，似乎突破了重重过滤，非要冲入商非凡的大脑。

叮咚。

系统的提醒声盖过了其他所有声音。

【任务二十二完成，你在未知区域的危险地图成功活过三个小时，奖励3点贡献点。】

【发现主线任务！系统开始更新，更新期间，无法下线。请待在原地不要挪动，等待更新结束。】

商非凡整个身体都凝固住，想动也动不了，他的右眼视界中-出现了一条进度条，正在缓慢往前推动。

这种被控制的状态真的太糟糕！

怎么样才能在这游戏里获得真正的自由，而不是游戏系统想对他做什么就对他做什么？

是不是脑载系统才会这么控制他的身体？

外置的笔记本系统是不是会更安全一点？

商非凡尝试让自己下线，发现果然就跟脑载系统第一次卡住时一样，无论他怎么用力想要下线，可他仍旧待在这个游戏世界。

如果脑载系统出现bug，把他的意识永久卡在游戏世界中，他在外面的身体会不会就此变成植物人？

老商不想继续胡思乱想，就在脑中勾勒出一款某厂最新研发的枪支，拆解再组装，确保自己能把所有零件的形状都勾勒出来。

这是一种很好地训练大脑空间思维能力的方法，就是特别枯燥。

老商一口气勾勒和拆解了不下十种枪型，终于听到了系统宣布更新完成的声音。

【系统更新完毕，修改已知bug，增添以下新功能：回城存档，模拟笔记本系统，开通与玩家笔记本系统兼容的新任务系统，开通与玩家笔记本系统兼容的通讯系统，线下通知，受外界影响的即刻脱离。详情请阅……】

商非凡身体终于可以动弹，继而发现这几个新增加的功能都对他有极大帮助。

首先是回城存档，相当于他拥有了一个可以任由自己设定坐标的单向传送阵。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 32: Main Quest (Part 1)

"A-Cheng, wake up..."

Shang Feifan lifted the little sable, whose eyes were wide open yet showed very little reaction, shaking it repeatedly and even patting its cheeks, but he still failed to snap it back to consciousness.

Fortunately, the little sable had a small physique, only about the length of an arm, making it easy to carry around as he walked.

Shang Feifan hoped the game system or his right eye would give him a hint, such as telling him where this place was and how to leave, but both remained completely silent without a single prompt.

Shang Feifan opened the game map once more, though unfortunately, his game map could only display places he had already explored...

Hmm? Unknown Area One and Unknown Area Two—what did this mean?

Shang Feifan simply zoomed out the map, pulling up all the map data he had ever recorded in the game, and shrank it down repeatedly in an attempt to view the full picture of the map.

Following that, Shang Feifan mentally applauded his own clever move.

He saw the shape of this world: a perfect sphere that looked as though it had been bitten twice by an insect.

This bitten planet was named Tianhe Star.

The places he had explored were all marked out within the spherical body.

It was just that this map was rather crafty, refusing to label oceans, landmasses, and islands, merely dotting a few black spots across a blank expanse and attaching names to indicate that these were places he had once explored.

However, judging by the locations of the black spots, combined with the overall spherical map and latitude/longitude lines, he could roughly deduce that the places he had explored were all situated in the Northern Hemisphere of Tianhe Star, between the North Pole and the equator, closer to the North Pole, belonging to a temperate climate zone.

As for the two bites taken out of Tianhe Star, one was located in the Northern Hemisphere, quite a vast distance away from the maps he had explored. The other was situated in the Southern Hemisphere close to the equator.

Yet neither Unknown Area One nor Unknown Area Two had any landing points marked on the map!

These two areas, specially marked as red dots, hovered above the map like floating cities in the sky.

Moreover, the map explicitly attached a single sentence to both unknown areas: Coordinates untraceable.

Didn't this imply that these two unknown areas were likely located in another dimension?

Whether the two unknown areas were in another dimension wasn't something Shang Feifan cared about deeply; it was a game, after all, and they could set it however they pleased. Even if they turned the entire world into overlapping multi-dimensional spaces, he wouldn't be surprised.

What made him happy and eager to applaud was that he now knew the exact directions from the Heavenly Residual Valley to the Bandit Den and the Moyue Mountain Valley Town, and could even calculate the approximate distances.

He truly had overlooked this map function far too much previously!

Who knew what other useful functions might still be hidden within the game system, waiting for him to discover and unearth.

Shang Feifan stood right where he was, carefully examining the various functions of the game system.

He had seriously analyzed this system before, but now he was looking at it in finer detail, attempting to unearth the hidden functions of each item.

The ruined city was exceptionally quiet, seemingly devoid of any danger.

Perhaps because Shang Feifan was acting too relaxed and showed zero drive, the system finally couldn't help itself and issued a new quest for him.

[Quest 23: Please explore the ruined city before you. For every ten percent increase in exploration progress, be rewarded with 1 Contribution Point.]

Shang Feifan wiped away his smile and looked up.

Businessmen knew that seizing the initiative was crucial in business, but one must never be overly hasty. Sometimes, taking a roundabout approach could better achieve one's goal; it was all a contest of who could keep their composure longer and who was more desperate to reach the objective.

Before figuring out a way to leave, he would have needed to explore this city anyway, but now he had anywhere from 1 up to a maximum of 10 Contribution Points waiting to be credited to his account.

Shang Feifan's eyes locked once more with the eyes of the statue.

Countless frenzied, agonizing, shrill, weeping, and roaring cries surged toward him once more.

Yet, perhaps due to the protection of the God of Curses, these sounds could no longer harm his cerebral nerves, feeling as though they were filtered through multiple layers of insulation.

Even so, those hollow eyes, seemingly brimming with extreme emotions, still held a strong attraction for him, compelling his feet to involuntarily walk toward the city center where the statue was seated.

Avert your gaze!

Shang Feifan commanded himself in his mind, using his utmost willpower to force his head to turn, dragging his eyes away from the gaze of the statue's eyes.

It was unsuccessful.

His consciousness was crystal clear; he knew he was being seduced by the statue's eyes, yet he still walked involuntarily toward the direction of the statue.

Old Shang hated being manipulated like a puppet by an unknown existence, but at the same time, he was curious about what purpose the statue had in compelling him to walk over.

Caught in this contradiction, Shang Feifan gradually drew closer to the statue.

The little sable A-Cheng had been left behind by him where he stood.

The closer he got, the clearer he could see. Neither the body nor the face of this statue revealed any obvious gender characteristics; clad in primitive battle armor, you could call it female just as easily as you could view it as male. Those broad chests could just as well be pectoral muscles!

He felt as though he had been walking for a very long time; the muscles in both legs and the soles of his feet ached with a familiar soreness.

He even began to feel hunger and thirst.

Yet he had not split his focus along the entire journey, nor did he spare a single extra glance at the ground or the sides of the road, marching straight up to the base of the statue.

This statue had no foundation block; its feet landed directly upon the ground.

Shang Feifan tilted his head up to look at the statue. Standing close to it, he wasn't even as tall as a single one of the statue's toes.

Looking at it this way, while he couldn't take in the full picture of the statue, he could more clearly see the dense web of cracks covering its body, as if it could shatter and turn into a pile of rubble at any moment.

Pitiable statue; viewed up close, one realized it was missing even more parts.

For instance, the pinky toe on the foot right before him was missing entirely.

Shang Feifan raised his hand, as though spellbound, lifting his palm high until it landed squarely on the statue's... instep.

This was his final shred of defiance.

The chaotic sounds abruptly amplified, seemingly breaking through the heavy layers of filtration to punch straight into Shang Feifan's brain.

Ding-dong.

The system's notification sound drowned out all other noises.

[Quest 22 completed. You have successfully survived for three hours in the dangerous map of the Unknown Area, rewarded with 3 Contribution Points.]

[Main Quest discovered! The system is initiating an update. During the update, logging off is prohibited. Please stay in place without moving and wait for the update to conclude.]

Shang Feifan's entire body froze up, unable to move even if he wanted to. A progress bar appeared in his right-eye field of vision, slowly creeping forward.

This state of being controlled was truly terrible!

How on earth could one achieve true freedom in this game, rather than having the system do whatever it pleased with him?

Was it this neural-loaded system that controlled his body like this?

Would an external laptop system be somewhat safer?

Shang Feifan attempted to log off, only to find that, just like when the neural-loaded system first glitched, no matter how hard he tried to force a log-out, he remained trapped in this game world.

If the neural-loaded system experienced a bug that permanently locked his consciousness inside the game world, would his physical body outside end up becoming a vegetable?

Unwilling to let his imagination run wild, Old Shang visualized a firearm recently developed by a certain manufacturer in his mind, repeatedly disassembling and reassembling it to ensure he could outline the shape of every single component.

This was an excellent method for training spatial cognitive abilities in the brain, albeit exceptionally tedious.

Old Shang visualized and disassembled no fewer than ten types of firearms in one go, finally hearing the system announce that the update was complete.

[System update complete. Known bugs patched, and the following new features added: Return-to-City Save Point, simulated laptop system, a new quest system compatible with the player's laptop system, a communication system compatible with the player's laptop system, offline notifications, and instant detachment upon external influence. For details, please read...]

Shang Feifan's body could finally move again, and he subsequently discovered that these newly added functions would be of immense help to him.

First was the Return-to-City Save Point, which was equivalent to possessing a one-way teleportation array whose coordinates he could set at will.

chunks.chineseText:
只要是他去过的地方，他就可以随意设置某个地方为自己的回城存档点。当他使用回城功能时，他就能被及时传送回自己设定的回城点。

这个回城功能不但可以减少大量赶路的劳累，更能当做救命法宝使用，比如千钧一发之际可以直接发动回城功能闪人。

只是这个回城功能的冷却时间比较长，每天只能使用一次，冷却一次就要二十四小时。每次发动也需要十秒时间。而且用一次就要1点贡献点。

但总体来说，这还是一个非常实用的功能。如果能不花贡献点就更好了。

可换个方向思考，相当于1点贡献点可以买一张定点传送劵，就也很划算。

模拟笔记本系统这一功能则非常鸡贼，脑载系统显然也不打算掩饰它和笔记本系统不是一家的事了。

它不但能变成笔记本系统的外形，还能兼容它的功能！

对于这个鸡贼功能，商非凡个人还是蛮喜欢的，这样他就不用特意花钱去补一个笔记本系统。

兼容通讯系统，能保证他在游戏中联系上伏向军和其他玩家，同时还能看到其他玩家在世界频道上发出的实时动态。

兼容任务系统，他就能通过做任务赚游戏币，相当于是双重收益。

剩下的可以接受线下通知功能、以及受外界影响的即刻脱离功能，则能让他少了很多后顾之忧，安全性也更高。

片刻后，一阵庄重的音乐响起，仪式感十足。

商非凡：来了！

【主线任务！你发现了残损的自然之神雕像，请寻回所有遗失的雕像残损部分，并把它们还给自然之神雕像。任务完成后，你将得到一个特别奖励——系统将会实现你一个愿望。注：请不要提不切实际的愿望。】

【主线任务一，请寻回自然之神雕像残损部分之一半的额头，完成后奖励一万点贡献点。】

【主线任务二，请寻回自然之神雕像残损部分之一只眼睛，完成后奖励一万点贡献点。】

【主线任务三，请寻回自然之神雕像残损部分之一只耳朵，完成后奖励一万点贡献点。】

【主线任务四，……】

总结下来，自然之神雕像一共缺失了九个部位，分别是一半额头、一只眼睛、一只耳朵、一支手臂、一颗心脏、一块小腹、一枚脚趾、一支权杖、以及一条腰带。

全部找回来，他可以得到九万贡献点，和实现一个愿望。

奖励不可谓不丰厚。

甚至系统还一改往日风格，在最后特意询问他：【是否接受任务？】

商非凡：这还用问吗？谁玩游戏会特意避开主线任务？更别说收益还这么丰厚！

“接受。”

瞬间，商非凡的右眼视界中-出现了一个寻宝罗盘。

该寻宝罗盘和游戏中常见的寻宝罗盘没有多大区别，都是给出一个方向箭头，让你跟着箭头走。到达任务物品的一定范围内，再给出精确距离。

收起来。商非凡默念。

寻宝罗盘立刻从右眼视界中消失。

出来。

寻宝罗盘又冒了出来。

金黄色的箭头转来转去，似乎无法准确定位。

商非凡一下想到，这里是未知区域，很可能是和天河星不一样的特殊空间。他恐怕得离开这个未知区域，寻宝罗盘才能起到真正作用。

商非凡再次仰起头，看向雕像。

不知道是不是他的错觉。

在他接受了主线任务后，原本一直徘徊在他耳边萦绕不去的狂乱叫喊声一瞬间全都消失了。

同样，他再看雕像剩下的那只眼睛，也不再感到诱惑，顶多就觉得这只眼睛雕刻得非常传神。

就好像这座自然之神雕像已经知道他建负着寻找它身躯缺失部分的重任，把他暂时划作了自己人。

商非凡终于有闲心可以打量周围环境。

雕像所处的地方不但是市中心，还是一个很大的广场。

围绕雕像，广场边沿摆放了一块又一块像是碑文的石刻。

这些石碑有大半被损毁，只有少数几块完整，剩下的全都缺角少边。

商非凡走到这些石碑边，低头观看。

石碑上有字。

重点——他能看得懂！
chunks.englishText:
Wherever he had been, he could freely designate any location as his Return Point. When he used the Return function, he would be instantly teleported back to the designated spot.

Not only could this Return function eliminate a massive amount of travel fatigue, but it could also serve as a life-saving trump card—for instance, directly triggering the Return function to make a clean getaway in the nick of time.

It was just that the cooldown for this Return function was rather long. It could only be used once a day, requiring a full twenty-four hours to reset. Each activation also took ten seconds. Furthermore, every use cost 1 Contribution Point.

Overall, however, this was still an immensely practical feature. It would be even better if it didn't cost any Contribution Points.

Yet, looking at it from another perspective, equivalent to buying a fixed-point teleportation scroll for 1 Contribution Point, it was actually quite cost-effective.

The Simulation Notebook system feature, on the other hand, was utterly sly; the cranial system clearly had no intention of hiding the fact that it wasn't made by the same people as the Notebook system.

Not only could it transform into the appearance of the Notebook system, but it could also fully replicate its functions!

As for this sneaky feature, Shang Feifan personally rather liked it, as it meant he wouldn't have to deliberately spend money to acquire a separate Notebook system.

Compatibility with the communication system ensured that he could stay in touch with Fu Xiangjun and other players within the game, while simultaneously viewing real-time updates posted by other players on the world channel.

Compatibility with the quest system meant he could earn game currency by completing quests, which was practically a double yield.

The remaining features—accepting offline notifications and immediate detachment when subjected to external influences—left him with far fewer worries and provided an even higher level of safety.

A moment later, a solemn piece of music began to play, brimming with a strong sense of ritual.

Shang Feifan: Here it comes!

[Main Quest! You have discovered the damaged Statue of the God of Nature. Please retrieve all the lost, damaged parts of the statue and return them to the Statue of the God of Nature. Upon completing this quest, you will receive a special reward—the system will grant you one wish. Note: Please refrain from making unrealistic wishes.]

[Main Quest I: Please retrieve half of the forehead, one of the damaged parts of the Statue of the God of Nature. Upon completion, the reward will be ten thousand Contribution Points.]

[Main Quest II: Please retrieve one of the eyes, one of the damaged parts of the Statue of the God of Nature. Upon completion, the reward will be ten thousand Contribution Points.]

[Main Quest III: Please retrieve one of the ears, one of the damaged parts of the Statue of the God of Nature. Upon completion, the reward will be ten thousand Contribution Points.]

[Main Quest IV: ……]

To sum it up, the Statue of the God of Nature was missing a total of nine parts: half of a forehead, one eye, one ear, one arm, one heart, a piece of the lower abdomen, a toe, a scepter, and a belt.

If he found them all, he would obtain ninety thousand Contribution Points and the fulfillment of a single wish.

The rewards could hardly be described as anything less than generous.

Even the system broke away from its usual style and specifically asked him at the very end: [Do you accept the quest?]

Shang Feifan: Do I even need to ask? Who plays a game and intentionally avoids the main quests? Not to mention the rewards are this lavish!

"Accepted."

In an instant, a treasure-hunting compass appeared within the field of vision of Shang Feifan's right eye.

This treasure-hunting compass was no different from the common ones found in games; it simply gave a directional arrow telling you to follow it. Once you reached a certain range of the quest item, it would display the precise distance.

Store it away, Shang Feifan thought silently.

The treasure-hunting compass immediately vanished from the field of vision of his right eye.

Come out.

The treasure-hunting compass popped right back out.

The golden arrow spun around in circles, seemingly unable to pinpoint a precise location.

Shang Feifan immediately realized that this was an unknown zone, most likely a special space different from the Tianhe Star. He would probably have to leave this unknown zone for the treasure-hunting compass to truly serve its purpose.

Shang Feifan raised his head once more to look at the statue.

He wondered if it was just his imagination.

The moment he accepted the main quest, the frantic, lingering screams that had continuously echoed around his ears all vanished in an instant.

Likewise, when he looked at the remaining eye of the statue again, he no longer felt any temptation, finding it at most exquisitely and vividly carved.

It was as if this Statue of the God of Nature already knew he bore the heavy responsibility of finding the missing parts of its body, temporarily classifying him as one of its own.

Shang Feifan finally had the leisure of mind to survey his surrounding environment.

The location of the statue was not only at the city center, but also a massive plaza.

Encircling the statue, stone carvings resembling stele inscriptions stood along the edge of the plaza.

More than half of these stone steles were ruined, with only a few remaining intact while the rest were chipped and battered.

Shang Feifan walked up to these steles and lowered his head to inspect them.

There were words inscribed on the steles.

Crucially—he could understand them!
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第33章 历史的一部分 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第33章 历史的一部分

【公历10008年10月17日，一位改变整个世界发展历程的伟人诞生了。他让科技真正成为兽人大陆发展的另一支大腿，他让弱小普通无法激活神血天赋和天赋较弱的兽人们也拥有了不亚于神血兽人的力量！

更可贵的是，他发明创造的科技物品以及用科技手段提炼的药物统统价廉物美，让全兽人大陆再也不用为攒钱购买昂贵的炼金物品和只有祭司才能炼制的巫药而苦恼。

当时，无数的人恨他妒忌他，更有无数人爱他尊敬他崇拜他。

时间证明，他点亮的科技线是多么璀璨耀眼又实用的力量。

在他晚年，兽人世界掀起了有史以来的最大战争，那是底层兽人和奴隶兽人为自己的自由和权力，向腐朽残忍以血脉论贵贱的神血皇族发动的疯狂抗议。

最终结果，我们都已经知道，历史告诉了我们答案。

当神血皇族们以为低贱的奴隶兽人和底层兽人无论如何都不可能推翻他们，以为这一次的抗争也会像以前无数次的抗争一样被残酷镇压。

可他们没想到，底层兽人和奴隶兽人虽然无法拥有强大的个人力量，但他们拥有了用科技制作出来的武器，大量的、廉价的、只要有手有材料就可以制作出来的非炼金武器！

他们还有用科技手段提炼出来的大量药物，效果也许没有祭司们炼制出来的巫药疗效那么快和好，但胜在量大、价格低廉、且容易获取，几乎每一个受伤的革-命战士都能得到有效治疗。

延续时间长达四十三年之久的自由战争终于胜利了！神血皇族被推翻，兽人世界从此再也没有皇帝，也再也没有奴隶。所有的兽人生而平等，法律也再没有针对贵族和神血战士的特殊条款。

最终我们迎来了现在平等、繁荣、自由和有尊严的安宁生活。赞美兽人联盟！赞美联盟法律！

让我们用更大的声音赞美他吧，为我们带来自由和希望的，伟大的科技之父——战书恒先生！

也让我们铭记他和他家族的无私奉献，战书桓先生同时也是战氏家族最后一位血脉。

因为神血皇族对战书恒先生的仇恨，神血皇族无视大祭司的阻拦和劝告，竭尽全力抓捕杀害了所有战氏族人，不顾战氏家族乃是战神血脉后裔的传言。

战氏家族也为此奋战到了最后一人，没有一个战氏族人向神血皇族屈服，他们全都站着死去！

从此，兽人世界再也没有战氏族人。战神血脉就此断绝！

但战神和他的血脉后裔战书桓先生永远都活在我们心里。战神从来都不是神血的拥趸，战神是意念，是兽人们不屈的意志！当世界开始偏颇时，战神就会出现，祂会用任意形式鼓舞受屈者的灵魂……】

商非凡看得心血有一点澎湃。

历史的转折点总会有英雄人物出现，他们或是推动，或是领导，或是成为导-火-索。

在以神血力量为主流的兽人世界想要发展科技，就跟古早以儒道为尊的夏国想要发展民科一样，只会被鄙视、被打压。那时科技甚至被视为下九流的把戏。

但就像纸包不住火一样，科技的力量也无法永远被压抑，它终将会爆发出可怕的力量，顶翻压在它身上的重负，获得自由、获得发展。

而任何力量都不可能无限制地发展下去，否则得到的终将是毁灭。

商非凡看完这段历史伟人的介绍，对这个游戏世界的背景产生了一些猜测。

如果力量变得容易掌握，那么现在的兽人世界会不会就是肆意使用这份力量的后果？

这就像两个赤手空拳的人互相殴打，也许会彼此打到重伤，但七成以上不会把人打死。可如果两个人都持有枪械呢？

力量没有错误，只是看要如何限制它以及更聪明地使用它。

商非凡走到了第二块看起来八成完整的石碑前。

【历史总是在轮回。

某一天人们忽然发现，天生就拥有神血天赋的兽人越来越少，反而是天生就是天残的兽人却越来越多。

兽人们惶恐了。如果被称为兽人的我们失去了在人体和兽体之间自由转换的天赋，我们还是兽人吗？

而兽人中能变化出巨大躯体的巨兽也变成了少数派。

原本十个兽人中就算没有人人都觉醒神血天赋，但人人都可以变身成巨兽，这是兽神赐予兽人们的最特殊能力，可以让兽人更容易捕猎到食物也更容易在危险的兽人大陆生存下去。

可现在一百个兽人中也不一定有一个觉醒神血的兽人，能变身为巨兽的兽人也不到十分之一。

神血兽人、巨兽兽人变得珍稀，同时拥有神血天赋和能变身巨兽的兽人更成了极少数的稀有存在。人们又开始疯狂渴望和崇拜这些稀少存在。

阿莫斯布莱顿，一位自称有古神血皇族血脉的巨星，他拥有让植物生长的神血天赋，他的拥趸称他为自然之神的神血后裔。他同时还能变身成巨兽，一只生有双翅的巨角龙族！

当阿莫斯布莱顿展现他的天赋时，六成以上的兽人都会为之疯狂，剩下的兽人则充满妒忌。

在阿莫斯布莱顿的名气最如日中天时，一个以他为教宗的新兴教派出现了，神血教。

该教派一出现就以比病毒更可怕的速度蔓延了整个兽人世界，加入神血教派的年轻兽人比比皆是。

阿莫斯布莱顿有了新的称呼，他的教众以及全世界的年轻兽人都称他为阿莫斯教皇！

在神血教中，想要加入中高层，你必须觉醒神血，或能变身成巨兽。

当时的联盟高层并没有把这个新兴教派放在眼里。

绝大多数自认理智的兽人也都以为这个以少数派为尊的教派会像以往各种教派一样，会很快地从兴盛走向势微。甚至当时不少评论家都认为只要阿莫斯布莱顿去世，这个教派就会灭亡。

可谁也没有想到，神血教竟然推出了神血觉醒药剂和巨兽体觉醒药剂。

虽然两种药剂的成功率传言不到百分之四，但早就厌恶自身太过普通的兽人们狂涌而至，每个人都渴望成为珍稀的少数派，为了能求到两种药剂，普通兽人们不惜付出一切。

神血教只花了不到十年时间就成了兽人世界第一大教派，就连圣山祭司宫都无法阻挡其发展势头。

公历17555年5月5日，这一天也被后世称为五五神血日。神血教对外宣称他们的神血觉醒药剂和巨兽体觉醒药剂的觉醒成功率达到了百分之五十五，同时他们还推出了一款新药剂——延寿药剂！

兽人世界的发展再次来到了一个巨大的转折点，此后百年，神血教势力笼罩了整个兽人世界。已经快两百岁却仍旧保持着年轻英俊外表的阿莫斯布莱顿教皇在全民百分之七十六的高投票下，坐上了兽人联盟盟主的宝座。

公历17700年12月21日，阿莫斯布莱顿盟主在连任两届盟主之位后，修改最高法律，改兽人联盟制为兽人帝国制。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 33: A Piece of History

[On October 17th of the 10008th year of the Gregorian calendar, a great man who changed the developmental course of the entire world was born. He made technology truly become the other pillar supporting the development of the Orc Continent; he allowed weak ordinary orcs who could not activate divine blood talents and those with weaker talents to also possess power no less than that of the divine blood orcs!

Even more precious was that the technological items he invented and the medicines extracted through technological means were all inexpensive and of high quality, freeing the entire Orc Continent from ever having to fret over saving money to purchase exorbitant alchemical items and witchcraft potions that only priests could refine.

At that time, countless people hated him and envied him, while countless more loved him, respected him, and worshiped him.

Time proved just how brilliant, dazzling, and practical the technological path he lit up truly was.

In his later years, the orc world erupted into the greatest war in history—a frantic protest launched by the bottom-tier orcs and slave orcs against the decayed, cruel divine blood imperial family, which judged nobility based on bloodlines, fighting for their own freedom and rights.

The final outcome is something we all already know; history has given us the answer.

When the divine blood imperial families thought that the humble slave orcs and bottom-tier orcs could never overthrow them no matter what, believing that this resistance would be brutally suppressed just like countless resistances before it.

Yet they did not expect that although the bottom-tier orcs and slave orcs could not possess formidable personal power, they possessed weapons made through technology—massive quantities, cheap, and non-alchemical weapons that could be crafted as long as one had hands and materials!

They also possessed vast quantities of medicines extracted through technological means. The effects might not have been as fast or as effective as the witchcraft potions refined by priests, but their advantage lay in their sheer volume, low cost, and ease of acquisition, allowing nearly every injured revolutionary soldier to receive effective treatment.

The War of Freedom, which lasted for a grueling forty-three years, finally achieved victory! The divine blood imperial family was overthrown, and from then on, there were no more emperors in the orc world, nor were there any slaves. All orcs were born equal, and the laws no longer contained special clauses targeting nobility and divine blood warriors.

Ultimately, we ushered in our present peaceful life of equality, prosperity, freedom, and dignity. Praise the Orc Alliance! Praise the Alliance's laws!

Let us raise our voices even higher to praise him—the great Father of Technology who brought us freedom and hope, Mr. Zhan Shuhong!

Let us also remember the selfless contributions of him and his family. Mr. Zhan Shuhong was simultaneously the last remaining bloodline of the Zhan family.

Because of the divine blood imperial family's hatred for Mr. Zhan Shuhong, they ignored the High Priest's obstruction and advice, pulling out all stops to capture and slaughter all the members of the Zhan family, disregarding the rumors that the Zhan family were the descendants of the God of War's bloodline.

The Zhan family fought to the very last man for this, and not a single member of the Zhan family bowed their heads to the divine blood imperial family; they all died standing tall!

From then on, there were no more members of the Zhan family in the orc world. The bloodline of the God of War was thus severed!

Yet the God of War and his bloodline descendant, Mr. Zhan Shuhong, will forever live in our hearts. The God of War was never a supporter of divine blood; the God of War is a state of mind, the unyielding will of the orcs! Whenever the world begins to lean off-course, the God of War will appear, and He will inspire the souls of the wronged in any form...]

Shang Feifan felt his blood surge slightly as he read this.

Heroic figures always emerge at the turning points of history; they either propel, lead, or become the spark.

Wanting to develop technology in an orc world dominated by divine blood power was just like wanting to develop popular science in the ancient Xia Country where Confucianism and Daoism were supreme—it would only be despised and suppressed. Back then, technology was even viewed as a vulgar, low-class trick.

However, just as paper cannot wrap up a fire, the power of technology could never be suppressed forever. It would ultimately erupt with terrifying might, casting off the heavy burdens pressing down upon it to achieve freedom and development.

Moreover, no power could develop infinitely without restraint; otherwise, the ultimate result would only be destruction.

Having finished reading this introduction of the historical great man, Shang Feifan formed some speculations regarding the background of this game world.

If power became easy to grasp, would the current orc world be the consequence of wantonly wielding that power?

This was akin to two bare-handed individuals brawling; they might inflict heavy injuries on each other, but there was a better than seventy percent chance they wouldn't beat each other to death. But what if both parties were holding firearms?

Power itself is not wrong; it merely depends on how one restrains it and uses it more intelligently.

Shang Feifan walked over to the second stone stele, which appeared roughly eighty percent intact.

[History is always revolving in cycles.

One day, people suddenly discovered that orcs born with divine blood talents were becoming fewer and fewer, whereas orcs born with congenital defects were increasing by the day.

The orcs panicked. If we, who are called orcs, lose the talent to freely transform between human and beast forms, are we still orcs?

Furthermore, the colossal beasts among the orcs that could transform into gigantic physiques also became a minority.

Originally, even if not every single person out of ten orcs awakened divine blood talents, everyone could transform into a colossal beast. This was the most special ability bestowed upon orcs by the Beast God, allowing them to hunt for food more easily and survive more easily on the dangerous Orc Continent.

Yet now, out of a hundred orcs, not even one might awaken divine blood, and orcs capable of transforming into colossal beasts numbered less than one-tenth.

Divine blood orcs and colossal beast orcs had become rare, and orcs who simultaneously possessed divine blood talents and the ability to transform into colossal beasts became an absolute minority of scarce existences. People once again began to madly yearn for and worship these rare individuals.

Amos Brighton, a superstar who claimed to possess the bloodline of the ancient divine blood imperial family, possessed the divine blood talent to make plants grow, and his supporters hailed him as the divine blood descendant of the God of Nature. He could simultaneously transform into a colossal beast—a gigantic horned dragon born with twin wings!

When Amos Brighton displayed his talents, over sixty percent of orcs would go wild for him, while the remaining orcs were filled with jealousy.

At the absolute zenith of Amos Brighton's fame, a rising religious sect centered around him emerged: the Divine Blood Cult.

The moment this sect appeared, it spread across the entire orc world at a speed more terrifying than a virus, and young orcs joining the Divine Blood Cult were everywhere.

Amos Brighton acquired a new title; his followers and young orcs across the world all called him Pope Amos!

Within the Divine Blood Cult, to join the middle and upper ranks, you had to either awaken divine blood or be able to transform into a colossal beast.

The Alliance's higher-ups at the time did not take this emerging religious sect seriously.

The overwhelming majority of orcs who considered themselves rational also thought that this sect, which worshiped the minority, would rapidly decline from its prosperity just like all previous sects. Even many commentators of the time believed that the moment Amos Brighton passed away, this cult would perish.

Yet no one expected that the Divine Blood Cult would actually roll out the Divine Blood Awakening Potion and the Colossal Physique Awakening Potion.

Although the success rates of both potions were rumored to be less than four percent, ordinary orcs, who had long since grown disgusted with their own mediocrity, surged forward in droves, each desperately yearning to become a rare minority. To obtain the two potions, ordinary orcs were willing to pay any price.

It took the Divine Blood Cult less than a decade to become the largest religious sect in the orc world, and even the Sacred Mountain's Priest Palace was unable to stem the momentum of its development.

On May 5th of the 17555th year of the Gregorian calendar—a day later referred to by posterity as the May Fifth Divine Blood Day—the Divine Blood Cult publicly claimed that the awakening success rate of their Divine Blood Awakening Potion and Colossal Physique Awakening Potion had reached fifty-five percent. At the same time, they also launched a brand-new potion—the Longevity Potion!

The development of the orc world once again arrived at a massive turning point. For the next century, the influence of the Divine Blood Cult enveloped the entire orc world. Pope Amos Brighton, who was nearing two hundred years of age yet still retained a youthful and handsome exterior, ascended to the throne of the Orc Alliance Leader amidst a high approval rating of seventy-six percent of the entire population.

On December 21st of the 17700th year of the Gregorian calendar, Alliance Leader Amos Brighton, after serving two consecutive terms, modified the supreme laws to transition the Orc Alliance system into the Orc Empire system.]
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第33章 历史的一部分 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
公历17701年1月1日，阿莫斯布莱顿登基成为新兽人帝国第一位帝王。

……】

后面应该还有一些记录，可惜这块石碑的下半部分缺损了一些。

商非凡顾不上感叹，又走到第三块石碑前。

这块石碑竟然刻着一幅世界地图。

商非凡眼睛发亮，想要拍下这幅世界地图，却苦于系统没有这个功能。

他只能凭大脑记忆，可刚看了没两秒，眼前的一切就开始变得模糊。

怎么回事？

为什么我感觉到身体被挤压被排斥？

商非凡还没有搞清楚到底发生了什么，他就像是一颗被挤出来的皮球一样，噗地被挤出了废墟城市。

砰！

商非凡姿势有点难看的落到地面上。

啪，一只小貂也跟着落到他的脚边。

商非凡刚落地就弹身而起，他看起来放松，实际上肌肉每时每刻都做好了反击准备。

【警告！信徒精神力使用过度，现精神力值为33（-23）/100，想要再次进入未知区域二，请先恢复或增加你的精神力值。】

这是来自右眼的提醒。

系统不会称他为信徒。

商非凡挑眉。这么说他还能进入未知区域二？只要他的精神力值恢复到10点以上？

还有他的精神力值是怎么消耗掉的？难道待在未知区域二就会持续消耗精神力？

另外他要怎么再次进入未知区域二？

未知区域一是否也能再次进入？

右眼也好，系统也好，都没有给他更多提醒。

商非凡只能暂时转移注意力，专心观察周围环境。

熟悉又陌生的环境。

他回来了！

他又回到了强盗窝附近的河道边。

而且他落下的位置就是他和狰爷之前趴窝的草丛。

商非凡特意等了一会儿，没见到再有其他人出现。

狰爷和阿呆都不在原地，但商非凡并不是特别担心他们。

在未知区域一的时候，他就找过两只，但队伍里只有小貂，没有狰爷和阿呆。

之后他又观察了被绑队伍，发现里面的兽人全都是成年兽人，没有一个幼崽，也没有其他生物。

他只能推测狰爷和阿呆应该没有被一起抓过来。

悉悉索索，草丛里有响动。

商非凡低头。

“唔……”小貂清醒了。

“我的头好痛，我这是怎么了？”小貂摇晃着脑袋，含糊地咕哝。

商非凡把小貂提起来，“你没事了？”

小貂还一脸莫名其妙：“发生了什么事？啊，天亮了！”

小貂又立即紧张起来：“我们得赶紧离开这里，让那些强盗发现我们就惨了！咦？你的巨虫坐骑呢？”

商非凡盯着小貂的眼睛看了好一会儿：“你不记得发生什么事了？”

小貂一脸迷糊地摇头：“我只记得你把我和那个方脑袋的幼崽塞到巨虫坐骑背部的网兜里，然后……我感觉到周围特别安静，我都能听到我的心跳声……”

随着记忆一点点浮现，小貂脸上露出了恐惧神情：“我很害怕，我不知道怎么了，但我就是很害怕，就好像有什么极为可怕的东西出现了。”

小貂猛抬头，“后来发生了什么事？我是不是昏迷了？”

商非凡目光略复杂，语调轻松地道：“我也不知道，我跟你一样，应该也昏迷了过去，只比你早醒一点点。”

“那你的巨虫坐骑呢？还有那个幼崽呢？”小貂转头四处看。

商非凡：“不知道，我也正在寻找他们。”

“他们会不会被强盗抓回去了？”小貂紧张又担心。

“有可能。”商非凡心里则觉得不太可能，因为从他看到的被绑的强盗数量来看，他怀疑强盗窝里的强盗都被一网打尽了。他甚至在队伍中看到了疑为强盗窝头领的兽人。

“我打算去强盗窝看看。你留在这里等我。”

“呃，我……和你一起去。”小貂心里害怕回去，也怕一个人待着。

“不用。你在这里等我就行，躲好。”商非凡听到小貂肚子里发出的咕咕声，又追加一句：“我会带食物和清水回来。如果超过三个小时我还没有出现，你就自己离开。”

小貂还想要说什么，被商非凡抬手制止。

小貂想到他跟着过去也只会成为拖累，终于不再多言，而是在草丛里老实地找了个洞，藏了进去。

商非凡打开地图，又唤出了寻宝罗盘，一边向强盗窝摸过去。
chunks.englishText:
On January 1st of the 17701st year of the Gregorian calendar, Amos Brighton ascended the throne to become the first emperor of the new Orc Empire.

……]

There should have been some further records following this, but unfortunately, the lower half of this stone stele was damaged and missing.

Without time to dwell on his emotions, Shang Feifan walked over to the third stone stele.

This stone stele was actually carved with a map of the world.

Shang Feifan's eyes lit up, and he wanted to take a picture of this world map, only to be plagued by the fact that the system lacked this function.

He could only rely on his brain's memory, but barely two seconds after looking at it, everything before his eyes began to blur.

What is going on?

Why do I feel my body being squeezed and repelled?

Before Shang Feifan could figure out what on earth was happening, he was popped out of the ruined city like a squeezed-out rubber ball with a soft "pop."

Bang!

Shang Feifan landed on the ground in a somewhat unsightly posture.

Plop, a small marten also tumbled down and landed right beside his feet.

The moment he landed, Shang Feifan sprang up. Though he looked relaxed, his muscles were primed and ready for counterattack at every single moment.

[Warning! The believer has overused mental power. Current mental power value is 33 (-23)/100. If you wish to re-enter Unknown Zone II, please first restore or increase your mental power value.]

This was a reminder originating from his right eye.

The system would never refer to him as a believer.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. That meant he could still enter Unknown Zone II? As long as his mental power value recovered to above 10 points?

And how was his mental power value depleted in the first place? Could it be that staying in Unknown Zone II continuously drained mental power?

Besides, how was he supposed to enter Unknown Zone II again?

Could Unknown Zone I also be entered once more?

Neither his right eye nor the system provided him with any further prompts.

Shang Feifan could only temporarily divert his attention and concentrate on observing his surrounding environment.

A familiar yet unfamiliar environment.

He was back!

He had returned to the riverbank near the bandits' lair.

Moreover, the spot where he landed was precisely the patch of grass where he and Lord Zhen had previously been resting.

Shang Feifan deliberately waited for a while, but no other people appeared.

Neither Lord Zhen nor Dadao was in their original spot, but Shang Feifan was not particularly worried about them.

Back in Unknown Zone I, he had already searched for the two beasts, but only the small marten was in the party; Lord Zhen and Dadao were nowhere to be found.

Later on, when he observed the bound procession of captives, he discovered that all the orcs within it were adults, without a single cub, nor any other biological creatures.

He could only deduce that Lord Zhen and Dadao probably hadn't been captured together with them.

Rustle, rustle. There was movement in the grass.

Shang Feifan lowered his head.

"Ugh..." The small marten regained consciousness.

"My head hurts so much. What happened to me?" The small marten shook its head and mumbled incoherently.

Shang Feifan picked the small marten up by the scruff. "Are you alright?"

The small marten still wore a bewildered expression: "What happened? Ah, it's dawn!"

The small marten immediately grew tense: "We need to get out of here right now! It'll be disastrous if those bandits find us! Huh? Where's your giant insect mount?"

Shang Feifan stared into the small marten's eyes for a good long while: "You don't remember what happened?"

The small marten shook its head in utter confusion: "I only remember you stuffing me and that square-headed cub into the mesh pocket on the back of the giant insect mount, and then... I felt the surroundings become exceptionally quiet, to the point where I could hear my own heartbeat..."

As memories began to surface bit by bit, terror bloomed across the small marten's face: "I was terrified. I didn't know what was wrong, but I was just terrified, as if some extremely terrifying entity had appeared."

The small marten jerked its head up. "What happened afterwards? Did I pass out?"

With a somewhat complicated expression and a relaxed tone, Shang Feifan said, "I don't know either. Just like you, I probably passed out too, waking up only a tiny bit earlier than you did."

"Then where's your giant insect mount? And what about that cub?" The small marten turned its head to look around frantically.

Shang Feifan: "I don't know. I'm searching for them right now as well."

"Could they have been captured back by the bandits?" The small marten grew nervous and worried.

"It's possible." In his heart, however, Shang Feifan felt it wasn't very likely, because judging from the number of bound bandits he had seen, he suspected that the bandits in the lair had been wiped out in one fell swoop. He had even spotted an orc in the procession who was suspected to be the leader of the bandit den.

"I plan to go take a look at the bandits' lair. You stay here and wait for me."

"Uh, I... I'll go with you." The small marten was inwardly terrified of heading back, yet also scared of being left alone.

"No need. Just wait for me here and hide properly." Hearing the rumbling noises coming from the small marten's belly, Shang Feifan added another sentence: "I'll bring food and fresh water back. If I haven't shown up after three hours, leave on your own."

The small marten wanted to say something more, but was stopped by a wave of Shang Feifan's hand.

Realizing that following him would only make her a burden, the small marten finally swallowed her words, honestly found a hole in the grass, and hid inside.

Shang Feifan opened his map, summoned the treasure-hunting compass once more, and crept stealthily toward the bandits' lair.

chunks.chineseText:
第34章 储物空间

阿呆必要时完全不呆，就比如现在，他就没有和狰爷一直待在空荡荡的强盗窝里。

小家伙不知道强盗们去了哪里，害怕被强盗们堵在强盗窝里，在确定强盗窝里没有老商后，就让狰爷带他跑出了强盗窝。

但他也没有远离强盗窝，而是决定留在附近偷偷观察两天。

他也不知道老商去了哪里，不知道该到哪里找他，他唯一知道的线索是老商是和强盗们一起失踪的，他就以他那稀少的人生经验判断，认为只要能等到一个强盗出现，说不定就能知道老商的下落。

狰爷就带着小家伙在附近绕圈跑，主要就是寻找人踪。累了就回到强盗窝附近蹲守。

商非凡也不知道强盗窝里这时的具体情况，虽然他在未知区域一看到了不少强盗，但在靠近强盗窝时，他还是很谨慎地选择了潜伏慢行。

围墙上没有人，整个强盗窝安静的就像是死城。

商非凡从藏身处走出来，慢慢靠近强盗窝。

“爸爸！”

一声稚嫩的，惊喜的大叫传来。

商非凡转头，看到了远处站起来的狰爷，以及站在狰爷背脊上小小的阿呆。

狰爷驮着阿呆哒哒跑了过来。

阿呆还没靠近就从狰爷身上来了一个信仰之跃。

商非凡一把抱住跳下来的小家伙。

阿呆张嘴正要嚎。

商非凡飞速捏住他的嘴唇：“好了，我回来了，没事了，不准哭。”

阿呆眼睛里含着泪水，硬是把眼泪憋了回去，四只小爪子紧紧抱住了老商的手臂。

商非凡揉揉阿呆的脑袋，忽然发现这小东西顺眼了不少。

“爸爸，你去了哪里？我到处都找不到你。强盗窝里没有人，一个都没有。”

“强盗窝里没有人？你们进去过了吗？”

阿呆点头：“狰爷带我进去的，里面不但没有人，所有活物都没有了。”

商非凡抬头看向强盗窝，抱着阿呆跳上狰爷宽阔的背脊：“走，狰爷，到强盗窝里转转。”

他在那条串烧队伍里似乎看到了两个和他一起出逃的兽人，但他那时自顾不暇，也没时间去救那两人。

另外三个兽人连同那个玩家则不见踪影，也不知他们是成功逃脱了强盗窝范围，还是怎样。

要是当时他加那个玩家为朋友，现在就能和对方通讯，搞清楚他们具体发生了什么事。

但商非凡并不后悔当时没有和玩家相认，他觉得这个游戏的精彩特色之一就是玩家和游戏NPC之间几乎无法区分这点，只要玩家不张嘴的话。

大隐隐于市，在玩家面前冒充NPC的感觉也挺有意思。

对了，他现在能看到笔记本游戏系统世界频道的众玩家发言了。说不定那个玩家会说些什么？

商非凡坐在狰爷背上，打开世界频道。

在世界频道喊话的人不少，但也不算特别多。这个游戏想要使用世界频道喊话，二十字以下要付一个铜达铢，二十字以上一百字以内要付三铜，一百字以上要付一银。

不是实在有事，或者是钱多得没处花，玩家们一般不会在世界频道废话。

商非凡不断往上翻看，后发现有关键词和玩家ID搜索功能，就试着输入“强盗”一词进行搜索。

跳出了两条世界喊话信息，是接到了侦查强盗窝任务的玩家在炫耀，以及招聘高手共同完成这个任务。

商非凡注意了下，发出这两条世界信息的玩家的ID叫“最大杏鲍菇”。

“有GM吗？我有个建议，下次更新能不能把论坛链接也放进来，让玩家可以在游戏中也能打开论坛链接查看？”

脑载系统没有反馈功能，似乎就是不想让玩家烦它。

商非凡建议完，也不管系统有没有听见，把注意力重新放回到强盗窝。

狰爷轻轻松松地再次爬进强盗窝中。

这个营地一片寂静，果然不见一个活物，就连里面的虫子都消失了。

臭果的味道还有残留，但已经不如之前那么让人无法忍受。

狰爷和阿呆不想待在强盗窝里，除了担心强盗返回，很大原因也是因为受不了这股臭味。

商非凡让狰爷带着他们在整个强盗窝里跑了一遍，他特意进入强盗们睡觉的房间看了看。

最终确定一件事：这里真的就只是强盗们的一个窝点，一个营地，而不是他们真正居住的老巢。

因为这里没有孩子，也没有伴侣痕迹，几乎所有兽人都是单人床铺。

普通强盗睡的是大通铺，只有小头目以上才拥有自己的单间。

一个想要长久经营的强盗老巢不可能搞得和军营一样。

商非凡怀疑这些强盗的老巢应该就在附近，说不定还是一个看起来很普通的村落，而附近的兽人们可能都不知道那是强盗老巢。

如果是这样的话，这个营地和那个老巢之间肯定有联系。

强盗窝变空的事应该很快就会被发现。

在这之前……

商非凡的目光落到了被烧出黑色痕迹却依旧坚固紧闭的库房大门上。

这次，他终于可以购买他已经眼馋很久的万能-钥匙。

要价高达5个贡献点的万能-钥匙果然很好用。

那看起来坚固又复杂的门锁被轻易打开。

狰爷身躯太大，只能等在门外，商非凡担心库房里有机关，让阿呆继续待在狰爷背上。

还好，这只是一个很普通的强盗窝，在设置了那么坚固的大门和复杂的门锁后，强盗们并没有在库房里继续搞幺蛾子。

库房内部空间很大，这里像是一个天然的巨大半岩洞，被改造成了库房。

库房最引人注目也最多的货物就是大堆的小麦和一种袋装的灰色粉末。

商非凡沾了一点灰色粉末捻了捻，又略微尝了一点。

有一点点腥味，不像是粮食磨成的粉末，但这种粉末显然可以充当食物。

除了大堆粮食以外，库房里还零散摆放了一些箱子和乱七八糟几乎没有分类的物品。

这些箱子和物品一看就是抢来的赃物，值钱的东西被分成一堆，不怎么值钱的放在另一堆。

他还看到了自己的衣裤鞋和简易工兵铲。

商非凡没急着翻看这些货物，他看到了库房后方的墙壁上还有一扇小门。

小门很小，只能容许兽人弯腰钻进去，但它的门锁同样牢固又复杂。

商非凡使用万能-钥匙插-入锁孔，咔哒两声，门锁开了。

小门后的空间相当黑暗。

商非凡转头从赃物中翻出一盏油肚虫灯，再找到点火的物品，点燃。

小门后的空间只有十平左右，里面倒是不低矮，高度有三米多，比大库房阴冷，有点像是天然冷藏室。

冷藏室内靠墙放着一排排货架。

可惜货架上摆放的货物极少，只有三个小箱子。

商非凡带着一点好奇，打开了这三个显然比前面大库房货物更珍贵的小箱子。

他以为会看到三箱货币，结果箱子里摆放的竟然是药瓶。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 34: Storage Space (Part 1)

A-Dai was completely far from foolish when the situation called for it. Right now, for instance, he hadn’t stayed cooped up inside the empty bandit den with Fierce Lord.

The little fellow didn’t know where the bandits had gone and was terrified of getting trapped inside their stronghold. After confirming that Old Shang wasn't in the lair, he had Fierce Lord carry him and flee outside.

However, he hadn't gone far away; instead, he decided to stay in the vicinity and secretly observe for a couple of days.

He had no idea where Old Shang had gone, nor where to look for him. The only clue he had was that Old Shang had vanished along with the bandits. Relying on his meager life experience, he reasoned that as long as he could wait for a single bandit to show up, he might just find out Old Shang's whereabouts.

Fierce Lord had been trotting in circles nearby with the little fellow, primarily searching for human or beast-folk traces. When they got tired, they would return to the outskirts of the bandit den to stake it out.

Shang Feifan had no idea what the exact situation inside the bandit den was at this moment. Although he had seen quite a few bandits in the Unknown Region, as he approached the stronghold, he still cautiously chose to sneak and move slowly.

There was no one on the defensive walls; the entire bandit den was as dead and silent as a ghost town.

Shang Feifan emerged from his hiding spot and slowly approached the stronghold.

"Daddy!"

A youthful, pleasantly surprised shout rang out.

Shang Feifan turned his head and saw Fierce Lord standing up in the distance, with little A-Dai perched on its back.

Fierce Lord trotted over, carrying A-Dai with a *da-da-da* sound of its hooves.

Before they had even fully closed the distance, A-Dai executed a "leap of faith" right off Fierce Lord’s back.

Shang Feifan caught the tumbling little fellow in a tight embrace.

A-Dai opened his mouth, on the verge of howling.

Shang Feifan swiftly pinched his lips shut: "Alright, I'm back. Everything's fine, no crying allowed."

Tears welled up in A-Dai's eyes, but he stubbornly choked them back, wrapping his four little paws tightly around Old Shang's arm.

Shang Feifan ruffled A-Dai's head, suddenly finding this little critter a lot more pleasing to the eye.

"Daddy, where did you go? I couldn't find you anywhere. There’s no one in the bandit den, not a single person."

"No one in the bandit den? Did you guys go inside?"

A-Dai nodded: "Fierce Lord brought me in. Not only was there no one inside, but all the living creatures were gone."

Shang Feifan looked up at the bandit den, scooped up A-Dai, and leaped onto Fierce Lord's broad back: "Let's go, Fierce Lord. Let's take a spin around the bandit den."

He seemed to have spotted two beast-folk who had escaped with him in that line of skewered captives, but at the time, he could barely save his own skin and had no time to rescue them.

The other three beast-folk, along with that player, were nowhere to be seen. It was anyone's guess whether they had managed to escape the vicinity of the bandit den or suffered some other fate.

If he had added that player as a friend back then, he could communicate with him right now and figure out what exactly had happened to them.

However, Shang Feifan didn't regret failing to acknowledge the player at the time. He felt that one of the game's most fascinating features was how players and game NPCs were almost indistinguishable from one another—provided the player kept their mouth shut.

True seclusion is found in the bustling world; the feeling of posing as an NPC right in front of players was actually quite interesting.

Right, could he now view the world channel messages of players within the notebook's game system? Perhaps that player might say something?

Sitting on Fierce Lord's back, Shang Feifan opened the world channel.

There were quite a few people shouting in the world channel, though not an overwhelming number. To broadcast on the world channel in this game, one had to pay one copper *dazhu* for messages under twenty characters, three copper for messages between twenty and one hundred characters, and one silver for anything over a hundred characters.

Unless it was an absolute emergency or they had money to burn, players generally didn't talk nonsense on the world channel.

Shang Feifan scrolled upward continuously, discovering a keyword and player ID search function. He decided to try inputting the word "bandit" to search.

Two world broadcast messages popped up: one was from a player who had received a mission to scout the bandit den and was showing off, while the other was recruiting experts to complete this mission together.

Shang Feifan took note that the ID of the player who sent these two world messages was "Largest King Oyster Mushroom."

"Is there a GM? I have a suggestion: in the next update, can you also include the forum link so players can open and browse the forums directly inside the game?"

The brain-embedded system offered no feedback function; it seemed entirely determined not to let players bother it.

Having made his suggestion regardless of whether the system heard him, Shang Feifan refocused his attention on the bandit den.

Fierce Lord easily climbed back into the bandit stronghold.

This camp was dead silent; true to A-Dai's words, not a single living creature was to be seen, not even the bugs that used to crawl around.

The stench of the stinky fruit still lingered, but it was no longer as unbearable as before.

Fierce Lord and A-Dai didn't want to linger in the bandit den—apart from worrying about the bandits returning, a major reason was simply that they couldn't stand the smell.

Shang Feifan had Fierce Lord carry them through the entire bandit den, specifically entering the quarters where the bandits slept to take a look.

He finally confirmed one thing: this place was truly just an outpost, a campsite for the bandits, rather than their true permanent lair.

Because there were no children here, nor any traces of partners or mates; almost all the beast-folk had single beds.

Ordinary bandits slept on large communal kangs, and only those at the rank of minor squad leader or above had their own individual rooms.

A bandit lair intended for long-term operations could never be run like a military camp.

Shang Feifan suspected that the true lair of these bandits should be nearby, perhaps even disguised as an ordinary-looking village where the surrounding beast-folk might not even realize it was a bandit nest.

If that was the case, there must be a connection between this outpost and that home base.

The fact that the bandit den had become empty should be discovered very soon.

Before that happens...

Shang Feifan's gaze landed on the heavily bolted warehouse doors, which still bore black scorch marks but remained sturdy and tightly shut.

This time, he could finally afford to purchase the "Universal Key" that he had been eyeing for a long time.

The Universal Key, priced at a hefty 5 contribution points, was indeed exceptionally useful.

The sturdy and complex-looking lock was easily picked.

Fierce Lord's body was too large and could only wait outside the door. Fearing there might be traps inside the warehouse, Shang Feifan let A-Dai stay on Fierce Lord's back.

Fortunately, this was just an ordinary bandit outpost. Having set up such sturdy doors and complex locks, the bandits hadn't bothered to rig any nasty tricks inside the warehouse itself.

The interior space of the warehouse was quite vast. It looked like a natural, massive semi-rock cave that had been converted into a storehouse.

The most eye-catching and abundant goods in the warehouse were piles of wheat and a kind of bagged gray powder.

Shang Feifan dipped a finger into the gray powder, rubbed it between his fingers, and tasted a tiny bit.

It had a slight fishy smell, not like flour ground from grain, but this powder could obviously serve as food.

Aside from the massive piles of grain, the warehouse also held scattered chests and a disorganized array of unclassified items.

At a glance, these chests and objects were clearly plunder. Valuable items were sorted into one pile, while less valuable things were tossed into another.

He even spotted his own clothes, pants, shoes, and the makeshift military entrenching tool.

Shang Feifan didn't rush to rummage through these goods. He noticed a small door on the back wall of the warehouse.

The small door was tiny, just large enough for a beast-folk to crouch and squeeze through, but its lock was equally sturdy and complex.

Shang Feifan inserted the Universal Key into the keyhole. With two crisp clicks, the lock sprung open.

The space behind the small door was pitch black.

Shang Feifan turned around, rummaged through the looted goods to find an oil-belly worm lamp, found a fire starter, and lit it.

The space behind the small door was only about ten square meters, but the ceiling wasn't low—it stood over three meters high. It felt colder and gloomier than the main warehouse, somewhat resembling a natural walk-in refrigerator.

Rows of shelves lined the walls inside the cold storage room.

Regrettably, the goods placed on the shelves were extremely sparse, consisting of only three small chests.

With a touch of curiosity, Shang Feifan opened these three small chests, which were clearly far more precious than the cargo in the outer warehouse.

Expecting to find three boxes of currency, he was surprised to discover that the chests were filled with medicine bottles instead.

chunks.chineseText:
药瓶瓶身上都贴上了药名，还有简单的功效说明以及服用方法，最下方还有制作者的名字。除了没有生产日期和使用年限，看起来和现实世界的药物说明并没有多少区别。

【初级外伤药剂。功效：止血消炎，促进伤口愈合。使用方法：粉末均匀地洒在伤口表面，也可用附带的药棒进行涂抹。制作者：中级炼药学徒皮翰】

这种外伤药剂最多。

除此之外还有【初级烫伤药剂】、【止痒药剂】、【初级退热药剂】、【慢性胃炎缓和药剂】、【急性肠胃炎缓和药剂】、【风寒感冒治愈药剂】、【风热感冒治愈药剂】、【病毒性感冒治愈药剂】，以及【初级解毒-药剂】。

最后一口小箱子里摆放的药剂最少，但也最特殊。

商非凡看到药瓶名，眼睛就亮了。

竟然是【初级精神力恢复药剂】！

商非凡不客气地当即打开一瓶，仰头喝下。

第一次喝这种精神力恢复药剂，效果……妙极了！

老商感觉自己的大脑像是被抚慰了一般，特别舒服，思维也特别清晰。

这让他感觉世界都明亮了不少。

再看向个人数据，精神力值果然在回升，虽然回升速度慢了一点，但他的精神力值已经从刚才的10点跳到了11点，现在是33（-22）/100。

商非凡决定把这三口小箱子都笑纳了。

可惜他没有空间储物道具，否则这时候他就能搬空这个强盗窝库房……等等！

商非凡脑中闪过一道光。

这真的是灵机一动，他也不知道有没有可能。

商非凡看向打开的地图，之前未知区域一和二都是两个红色光点，当他被未知区域二给排斥出来后，未知区域二就变成了灰色。

可现在未知区域二却变成了绿色光点。

一红一绿，对比太明显。

商非凡有种说不出的冥冥感觉，他似乎和未知区域二建立了某种非常特殊的联系。

建立联系的原因？

应该就是他接受了寻找雕像残缺部分的任务。

而连接他和未知区域二之间的锁链则是……寻宝罗盘！

任务可是要求他找到残缺部分后交还给自然之神雕像，那要怎么才能算是交还？

他是不是还能回到那座废墟城市？

如果他推测为真，也许他可以试试……

试什么？

商非凡脑中想着未知区域二中那个被称为是自然之神的残损雕像，想得非常专心。他在脑中勾勒出了自然之神雕像的具体模样。

商非凡太专心，完全没注意到当他勾勒出自然之神的完整雕像后，他的精神力满值上升了一点，变成了34（-22）/100。

当他感觉那雕像的眼睛看向他时。

他真的再次看到了那座雕像！

他回到了那座城市废墟！

他手里还提着那口装了【初级精神力恢复药剂】的小箱子。

商非凡把小箱子放到广场的空地上。

回去那个冷藏室。商非凡在大脑中对自己下令。

唰！

一眨眼，他重新回到了冷藏室。

商非凡笑了。

这满满的成就感！他真是一个大聪明。

这一来一去，又消耗了他一点精神力值，但老商觉得特别值。

如果他的妄想能成真，他不就拥有了一个超级大的储物空间？

如果尝试出问题也没什么，反正这些货物都是白来的，全损失掉他也不心疼。

做人怎么能没有一点冒险精神呢。

商非凡耐心等待精神力值慢慢恢复。

等到重新变成11点，他就一手一口药箱，再次回到废墟城市中心广场。

之前提进来的药箱还在，完好无损。

商非凡放下药箱，脑中想着回去，又回到强盗窝仓库。

emmm，这样虽然能达到储藏物品的效果，可也太费精神力值。

有没有什么更经济实惠的方法，让他即能达到储物和取物的目的，又不会太过消耗自己的精神力？

咦？他的精神力满值什么时候变成了34点？

难道是因为他刚才频繁使用精神力的缘故？

商非凡也没多想，出门跟阿呆和狰爷打了个招呼，就待在库房里开始反复尝试。

在消耗了两瓶初级精神力恢复药剂后，他终于摸索出了未知区域二的“经济使用方法”。

那就是用自己的精神力网笼罩住他想要收取的物品，再在脑中勾勒自然之神的残损雕像，想着把这些物品送到广场，就能用最少的精神力携带更多的存储量，还不用他本人进出未知区域二。

至于这个精神力网是怎么出现并成型的，商非凡不得不感谢他的右眼，也就是他融入的那枚据说拥有黑暗之力的玻璃球。

当他想着能否使用自己的精神力来代替自己的手时，他的右眼就出现了一句提示，让他默念诅咒之神-的名字，请这位神灵帮忙编织他的精神力网。

他就抱着玩玩的心情——游戏嘛，何必顾忌太多。

然后他的精神力网就出现了。就跟一键技能的效果一样。

叮咚。

【恭喜你通过自我锻炼，自我觉悟了精神力的基础使用方法。特别奖励‘精神力修炼法-初级篇’。】

商非凡：今天可真是双喜临门！

比起借用神灵的力量，那当然还是自己掌握精神力修炼方法更好。

就是不知道玻璃球是不是知道用这种方法可以得到奖励？

还是这就是一个巧合？

不管如何，得到实惠的人都是他，商非凡特别高兴。

The medicine bottles all had labels pasted onto them, detailing the medicine names, simple descriptions of their efficacy, and instructions for use, with the maker's name inscribed at the very bottom. Apart from the lack of a production date and expiration period, they looked remarkably similar to pharmaceutical instructions from the real world.

[Primary Trauma Potion. Efficacy: Stops bleeding, reduces inflammation, and promotes wound healing. Usage: Sprinkle the powder evenly over the surface of the wound, or apply using the attached medicine stick. Maker: Intermediate Pharmacy Apprentice Pihan]

This type of trauma potion was the most abundant.

Aside from that, there were [Primary Burn Potion], [Anti-Itch Potion], [Primary Fever-Reducing Potion], [Chronic Gastritis Relief Potion], [Acute Gastroenteritis Relief Potion], [Cold and Flu Cure Potion], [Wind-Heat Cold Cure Potion], [Viral Cold Cure Potion], and [Primary Antidote Potion].

The potions in the final small chest were the fewest in number, yet the most unique.

The moment Shang Feifan read the name on the vial, his eyes lit up.

It was actually a [Primary Mental Power Recovery Potion]!

Without standing on ceremony, Shang Feifan immediately popped open a vial and downed it in one gulp.

Drinking this kind of mental power recovery potion for the very first time yielded an effect that was... simply marvelous!

Old Shang felt as though his brain had just been gently soothed; it felt exceptionally comfortable, and his thought processes became remarkably clear.

It made him feel as though the entire world had grown a shade brighter.

Checking his personal stats, his mental power value was indeed climbing back up. Although the recovery speed was slightly sluggish, his mental power had jumped from the previous 10 points to 11 points, currently standing at 33 (-22)/100.

Shang Feifan decided to graciously appropriate all three of these small chests.

It was a pity he lacked spatial storage items; otherwise, he could clean out this entire bandit den warehouse right now... Wait!

A flash of inspiration struck Shang Feifan's mind.

This truly was a sudden stroke of genius; he had no idea if it was even possible.

Shang Feifan looked at his opened map. Earlier, Unknown Regions One and Two had both appeared as red dots of light. The moment he was repelled out of Unknown Region Two, it had turned gray.

Yet right now, Unknown Region Two had shifted into a green dot of light.

One red, one green—the contrast was stark.

Shang Feifan had an inexplicable, mystical sensation that he had somehow forged a very special connection with Unknown Region Two.

The reason for establishing this connection?

It should be because he had accepted the quest to find the missing fragment of the statue.

And the chain linking him to Unknown Region Two was none other than... the Treasure-Hunting Compass!

The quest required him to find the missing fragment and return it to the Statue of the God of Nature. But how would that be considered a "return"?

Could he still return to that ruined city?

If his deduction held true, perhaps he could give it a try...

Try what?

Shang Feifan pictured the damaged statue known as the God of Nature within Unknown Region Two, focusing his thoughts intently. He mentally sketched out the exact appearance of the Statue of the God of Nature.

So engrossed was Shang Feifan that he completely failed to notice that the moment he pictured the complete Statue of the God of Nature, his maximum mental power limit ticked upward by one point, becoming 34 (-22)/100.

When he felt the eyes of that statue gaze back at him—

He truly saw that ruined city once more!

He was back in the central plaza of that ruined city!

And he was still holding the small chest filled with [Primary Mental Power Recovery Potion] in his hand.

Shang Feifan placed the small chest down onto the open ground of the plaza.

*Return to that cold-storage room,* Shang Feifan commanded himself mentally.

*Whoosh!*

In the blink of an eye, he was back in the cold-storage room.

Shang Feifan smiled.

Such a profound sense of achievement! He truly was a supreme genius.

This back-and-forth trip had consumed another point of his mental power value, but Old Shang felt it was entirely worth it.

If his wild fantasy could truly be realized, didn't that mean he possessed a supersized storage space?

If the experiment went awry, it was no big deal either; these supplies were all acquired for free, and he wouldn't feel any heartache if he lost them entirely.

How could one live without a bit of a pioneering spirit?

Shang Feifan patiently waited for his mental power value to slowly regenerate.

Once it ticked back up to 11 points, he grabbed a medicine chest in each hand and transported himself back to the central plaza of the ruined city once more.

The medicine chests he had brought in earlier were still sitting there, completely undamaged.

Shang Feifan set the new chests down, thought about returning in his mind, and popped right back into the bandit den warehouse.

*Emmm*, while this method achieved the goal of storing items, it was far too costly in terms of mental power.

Was there a more economical and efficient method that would allow him to achieve the purpose of storing and retrieving items without excessively draining his mental power?

Huh? When had his maximum mental power limit increased to 34 points?

Could it be because of his frequent use of mental power just now?

Without dwelling on it further, Shang Feifan stepped outside to greet Ah Dai and Lord Fierce before remaining inside the warehouse to begin experimenting repeatedly.

After consuming two more bottles of Primary Mental Power Recovery Potion, he finally figured out the "economical usage method" for Unknown Region Two.

That was to envelop the items he wanted to store using a web of his own mental power, then mentally visualize the damaged statue of the God of Nature while intending to send these items to the plaza. This way, he could carry a much larger storage volume with minimal mental power expenditure, without even needing to physically enter Unknown Region Two himself.

As for how this web of mental power had manifested and formed, Shang Feifan had to thank his right eye—specifically, that glass marble infused with the power of darkness said to reside within it.

When he had wondered whether he could use his mental power as a substitute for his hands, a prompt had appeared in his right eye, instructing him to silently chant the name of the God of Curses and ask this deity to help weave his mental power web.

He had merely gone along with it out of a playful mindset—after all, it was just a game; why fuss over too many details?

And then, his mental power web had actually appeared. It functioned just like a one-click skill effect.

*Ding-dong.*

[Congratulations on discovering and awakening the basic usage method of mental power through self-practice and self-realization. Special reward: 'Mental Power Cultivation Technique - Primary Chapter'.]

Shang Feifan: Today really is a double blessing!

Compared to borrowing the power of a deity, mastering a mental power cultivation technique on his own was naturally far better.

He just wondered if the glass marble had known he would receive a reward by using that method, or if it was simply a coincidence?

Regardless, he was the one reaping the benefits, and Shang Feifan was exceptionally pleased.

第35章 臭果与传说

商非凡离开库房的时候，偌大的库房已经变得空空荡荡，他还换上了自己原来的衣裤鞋和装备。

阿呆和狰爷都没有往库房里多看。

商非凡走的时候还把库房大门又好好锁上，他甚至还干出把自己指纹擦得干干净净的事。

这是基操，他只是习惯了。

商非凡却不知道，他给这个强盗窝强盗集体失踪事件又增添了一丝神秘色彩。

当强盗老巢的兽人过来查看情况，只发现一个空荡荡的营地。

他们百般奇怪，怎么都想不通这么多人都去了哪里。

他们确实看到了大厨房和食堂的着火痕迹，可其他地方并没有战斗痕迹，就好像所有强盗在灭火后就突然一起离开了营地，还带走了库房中的所有粮食和货物。

但这根本不可能。

这个强盗窝，他们经营了几十年才有现在的规模，就算要放弃也不可能一个家人都不通知，就这样离开。

更何况这里只是放着大量粮食和货物，强盗们这些年积累下来的金钱都藏在各自家里。他们就算想要抛弃家人离开，也不可能不把那些钱财带上——自己人知道自己人，当强盗的可没几个有那样的良心。

强盗老巢的兽人们还派出剩下的少数青壮在附近到处寻找大群兽人迁徙的痕迹，也没有任何发现。

为了不让附近兽人知道他们和强盗有关系，最终这些兽人只能抱着满心不解回到老巢。

强盗老巢的兽人们非常忧心，终日惶恐不安。

他们家家有钱财没错，但他们没有了青壮！

何况他们还要在冬日来临前购买大量粮食，到时候没有人押送，在途中就可能被人抢走。

等到了冬天，他们村子没有青壮防守，饥饿的虫兽凶禽攻击他们的村子，他们又要如何防守？

还有荒野中游荡的兽人，那些都是真正的强盗。

已经远离强盗窝的商非凡可不知道强盗家人们的忧心忡忡，知道了他也会说一声报应。

当天，商非凡在玩家的世界喊话中看到有人在炫耀，说他们小队接到了探索强盗窝的任务，正准备出发，然后问有没有想要探索野外的浪荡子，可以跟他们一起走，大家互相照应。响应者还不少。

商非凡当即就猜测到第一个领取该任务的“最大杏鲍菇”很可能已经死亡，而且给出了什么反馈，天残谷主才会再次发布探索强盗窝的任务。

果然，等到商非凡休息下线，刚上游戏论坛就看到了“最大杏鲍菇”在论坛上的咆哮。

这个咆哮贴还十分火热，闹腾了一天都没有掉下去。

“啊啊啊！我被吞吃了啊！我被一个看不见的可怕怪物给吞吃了啊！好多强盗也被吞吃了！我好不容易救出来的NPC也有一个被吃了！这是怎样的野外大boss！

别问我是怎么死的，我就感觉自己是被吞吃了，我能感觉到自己被消化掉！那种极致的恐惧！简直无法描述！

那一刻，所有人，我周围的所有兽人全都僵硬了，明明什么东西都没有出现，但我们的直觉、我们的每一根汗毛都在告诉我们，有极端可怕的东西出现了！

我发誓没有夸张，真的没有！

我死了，没办法打开游戏面板，看不到系统给我的提示。等我能重新上线后，我再告诉大家，我到底是被什么东西给吞吃了。

真的吓死我了！跟做了噩梦一样，吓得我在现实中弹起来，然后就发现自己已经死亡下线。不管你们信不信，我现实中的衣服都被冷汗湿透了。”

下面回帖嘲笑的、询问情况的人一个接一个。

“最大杏鲍菇”也很爱炫，绘声绘色地描述了自己被强盗捕捉、被关入地牢，以及被救的全部经过。

“那些强盗实力很强，我都不知道他们是怎么发现了我。你们看到我兄弟的帖子就会知道，他们比我更惨，直接就被强盗们杀死，现在死亡惩罚时间还没结束。

我是我们小队唯一的独苗，我还等着我兄弟们去救我。没想到我竟然先一步被人救了……”

“那个NPC真的好厉害！我怀疑他是某个重要角色，因为他的长相和身材都极佳，属于男人看了都得称赞那一挂，也会妒忌……为了不被删帖，我就不做详细描述了，只能告诉你们，当时我们都是裸着的！”

“可惜游戏系统到现在都没有开通拍照功能！”

下面回帖一片嗷嗷怪叫。

商非凡脸色淡定地看着“最大杏鲍菇”对他大段的各种赞美，继续往下看对方描述自己带着两个兽人逃跑的经过。

可能是看“最大杏鲍菇”愿意帮助那个生病的兽人，那个胆小的兽人就黏上了“最大杏鲍菇”，跟在他身后不放。

“最大杏鲍菇”抱着做任务的心情，也没驱赶他，就带着那个生病还没完全痊愈的兽人以及那个胆小兽人一起跑。

途中，那个生病兽人和他们分散，胆小兽人倒是一直跟着他，但没多久他们就被到处搜索的强盗找到，就在他们打算举手投降时，那个恐怖降临了。

商非凡把这个帖子从头看到尾，只分析出一个有用信息。

就是那个恐怖存在出现后，先吞吃了一部分兽人，这些被吞吃的兽人应该都已经死亡。然后又抓捕了一批兽人，送到了未知区域一。

他现在还不知道未知区域一是干什么的，以及为什么那恐怖存在要把兽人送去未知区域一。

同样，他也不知道为什么那个恐怖存在会突然降临。

直到五天后，他遇到了一支行商队伍，这支队伍正好要前往炼药之城摩罗城。

商非凡跟着他们同行了两天，从他们口中知道了一个当地传说。

年老的兽人坐在火堆边，喝着自酿的土酒，和年轻的兽人们闲扯谈。

商非凡用他做麦饼的手艺换来了这支商队所有兽人的好感，更何况商非凡还帮他们修理了快要损坏的车辆车轴。那可是最难修理的部分，一旦损坏，如果没有更换的零件，就只能抛弃那辆车子。

加上商非凡还带着一个小幼崽，另一个兽人同伴也瘦瘦小小，又有自己的坐骑，怎么看都没什么威胁，也不需要他们特意照顾，商队没怎么犹豫就同意了他希望同行的请求。

商非凡看大家谈兴正浓，就闲聊一样地说道：“我经过天残谷，走了大约两天路程，遇到一条巨大地裂，看不到两边，最宽的裂缝足有上百米。如果不是我的坐骑找到一条地底石桥，我都不知道该如何越过那条地裂。”

“啊，你说的地缝我知道，那可是著名的深渊裂缝。那地方总是会发生各种稀奇古怪的事情，还经常有人失踪。你要是沿着地缝继续往南走，会看到一座附近兽人搭建出来的石桥，商队一般都是从那里通过。”一名年轻兽人活泼地插话。

Chapter 35: Stinky Fruit and Legends (Part 1)

When Shang Feifan left the warehouse, the massive storehouse had been swept completely clean and left empty. He had even changed back into his original clothes, pants, shoes, and equipment.

Neither A-Dai nor Fierce Lord spared the warehouse a second glance.

Before leaving, Shang Feifan carefully locked the warehouse doors back up, even going so far as to meticulously wipe away his own fingerprints.

This was standard operating procedure; he was simply used to it.

Little did Shang Feifan know, his actions added an extra layer of mystery to the collective disappearance of the bandits in this outpost.

When the beast-folk from the bandit's home base came over to check on the situation, all they found was a deserted camp.

Puzzled to their wits' end, they couldn't fathom for the life of them where so many people could have gone.

They did indeed find scorch marks in the large kitchen and dining hall, but there were no signs of battle anywhere else. It was as if all the bandits had suddenly left the camp together right after putting out the fire, taking all the grain and goods from the warehouse with them.

Yet that was completely impossible.

This bandit den was something they had spent decades operating to reach its current scale; even if they wanted to abandon it, they couldn't possibly leave without notifying a single family member.

What's more, this place only held a massive amount of grain and supplies, whereas the wealth the bandits had accumulated over the years was hidden in their respective homes. Even if they wanted to abandon their families and flee, it was unthinkable that they wouldn't take those riches with them—thieves know thieves best, and very few bandits possessed that kind of conscience.

The beast-folk from the bandit home base even sent out their remaining few able-bodied young men to search everywhere nearby for traces of a large migration of beast-folk, but they found nothing at all.

To prevent the surrounding beast-folk from discovering their ties to the bandits, these beast-folk ultimately had to return to their nest harboring heavy confusion.

The beast-folk of the bandit lair were extremely anxious, living in daily terror and unease.

Sure, every household had wealth, but they lacked able-bodied men!

On top of that, they still needed to purchase a massive amount of grain before winter arrived. Without anyone to escort the shipment at that time, it was liable to be plundered on the road.

And when winter came, with no young men in their village to defend it, how were they supposed to fend off attacks from hungry insects, beasts, and fierce birds?

Not to mention the beast-folk roaming the wilderness—those were the true bandits.

Shang Feifan, who had already distanced himself far from the bandit den, knew nothing of the bandit families' anxiety. If he did, he would only offer a cold word of retribution.

That very day, Shang Feifan spotted a post in the players' world channel where someone was showing off, claiming that their squad had accepted a mission to explore the bandit den and were preparing to set off. They were asking if any wanderers wanting to explore the wilderness wanted to tag along so they could look out for one another. The respondents were quite numerous.

Shang Feifan immediately deduced that "Largest King Oyster Mushroom," the first player to accept the quest, had likely died and provided some sort of feedback, prompting the Master of Sky-Shatter Valley to reissue the exploration mission for the bandit den.

Sure enough, when Shang Feifan rested and logged off, the moment he hopped onto the game forums, he saw "Largest King Oyster Mushroom's" rant thread.

This complaining thread was exceptionally hot, buzzing with activity all day without dropping off the front page.

"Ahhhhh! I got swallowed! I was swallowed by an invisible, terrifying monster! A bunch of bandits got swallowed too! Even one of the NPCs I went through so much trouble to rescue got eaten! What kind of wilderness grand boss is this?!

Don't ask me how I died; I just felt like I was being swallowed, and I could actually feel myself being digested! That ultimate terror! It's simply indescribable!

At that moment, everyone—all the beast-folk around me—grew completely rigid. Clearly, nothing had appeared, but our intuition and every single hair on our bodies were screaming at us that an extremely terrifying entity had arrived!

I swear I'm not exaggerating, really, I'm not!

I died, so I couldn't open my game panel and didn't see the system prompt. Once I'm able to log back in, I'll let you all know what on earth swallowed me.

I was honestly scared to death! It was like a nightmare, scaring me so badly I bolted upright in real life, only to find out I had already died and logged out. Believe it or not, the clothes I was wearing in reality were soaked through with cold sweat!"

Replies mocking him and asking for details poured in one after another.

"Largest King Oyster Mushroom" loved showing off, too, and vividly described the entire process of being captured by bandits, locked in the dungeons, and rescued.

"Those bandits were insanely strong; I have no idea how they even spotted me. If you read my bro's post, you'll know they had it even worse than me—they got killed straight by the bandits, and their death penalty timer hasn't run out yet.

I was the sole survivor of our squad, waiting around for my bros to rescue me. Who would've thought someone else would rescue me a step ahead..."

"That NPC is seriously awesome! I suspect he's some kind of major important character, because his looks and figure are top-tier—the kind that other men would praise upon seeing, but also secretly envy... To avoid getting my post deleted, I won't go into detailed descriptions; I'll just tell you that we were all stark naked at the time!"

"Too bad the game system hasn't opened up a camera function yet!"

The replies below were filled with howling degenerates.

With a calm expression, Shang Feifan looked at "Largest King Oyster Mushroom's" lengthy and varied praises of him, continuing down to read the other party's description of his escape with the two beast-folk.

Perhaps seeing that "Largest King Oyster Mushroom" was willing to help the sick beast-folk, the cowardly beast-folk latched onto him and stuck to his heels like glue.

"Largest King Oyster Mushroom," holding the mindset of completing a quest, didn't chase him away either, and fled together with the sick beast-folk whose recovery wasn't yet complete and the cowardly beast-folk.

Along the way, the sick beast-folk got separated from them. The cowardly beast-folk did stick with him, but before long, they were tracked down by searching bandits. Just as they were about to raise their hands in surrender, that terror descended.

Shang Feifan read the thread from start to finish and extracted only one piece of useful information.

That was: after the terrifying entity appeared, it first swallowed a portion of the beast-folk—these swallowed beast-folk were likely all dead. Then, it captured another batch of beast-folk and sent them to Unknown Region One.

He still didn't know what Unknown Region One was used for, nor why that terrifying entity wanted to send beast-folk there.

Likewise, he had no idea why that terrifying entity had suddenly descended.

It wasn't until five days later that he encountered a merchant caravan, which happened to be heading toward the City of Alchemy, Moluo City.

Shang Feifan traveled alongside them for two days and learned a local legend straight from their lips.

An elderly beast-folk sat by the campfire, sipping home-brewed moonshine and chatting idly with the younger beast-folk.
